        <span class="text-2xl">👩‍🏫</span>
        <div>
          <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-lg sm:text-xl leading-tight">Panel Kontrol Guru — SMAN 1 Kutasari</h2>
          <p class="text-xs text-[#E3F1E7]">Kelas Aktif: <b id="admin-active-class-lbl" class="text-[#E9B44C]">X E1</b> • Versi: <b id="admin-version-lbl">v1.0</b></p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <button onclick="startStudentPreview()" class="m-btn btn-blue !py-1.5 !px-3.5 text-xs sm:text-sm">
          👁️ Preview Mode Siswa
        </button>
        <button onclick="openPublishModal()" class="m-btn btn-gold !py-1.5 !px-4 text-xs sm:text-sm">
          🚀 Publikasikan Perubahan <span id="pending-badge" class="hidden ml-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#D64933] text-white text-[11px]">!</span>
        </button>
        <button onclick="closeAdminPanel()" class="m-btn btn-chili !py-1.5 !px-3.5 text-xs sm:text-sm">
          ✕ Tutup
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Tab Navigasi Panel Guru -->
    <div class="bg-[#F2E5C6] px-4 py-2 border-b-2 border-[#E4D3AA] flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto shrink-0">
      <button class="pill-tab text-xs sm:text-sm active" data-admintab="classes" onclick="switchAdminTab('classes')">🏫 Kelas & Sesi (X E1–E7)</button>
      <button class="pill-tab text-xs sm:text-sm" data-admintab="slides" onclick="switchAdminTab('slides')">📑 Slide & Tata Letak</button>
      <button class="pill-tab text-xs sm:text-sm" data-admintab="media" onclick="switchAdminTab('media')">🎬 Video YouTube</button>
      <button class="pill-tab text-xs sm:text-sm" data-admintab="games" onclick="switchAdminTab('games')">🎮 Pilihan Games Evaluasi</button>
      <button class="pill-tab text-xs sm:text-sm" data-admintab="questions" onclick="switchAdminTab('questions')">📝 Bank Soal & Refleksi</button>
      <button class="pill-tab text-xs sm:text-sm" data-admintab="results" onclick="switchAdminTab('results')">📊 Hasil Evaluasi & Refleksi</button>
      <button class="pill-tab text-xs sm:text-sm" data-admintab="versions" onclick="switchAdminTab('versions')">🕒 Riwayat Versi & Cloud</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Isi Tab Panel Guru -->
    <div id="admin-tab-body" class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-6"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ================= MODAL KONFIRMASI PUBLIKASI & RINGKASAN PERUBAHAN ================= -->
<div id="modal-publish" class="hidden fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-black/65 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
  <div class="m-card max-w-xl w-full p-6 space-y-4">
    <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-[#1E4D2B]">🚀 Publikasikan ke Perangkat Siswa</h3>
    <p class="text-sm text-[#6E421F]">Perubahan di bawah ini akan tersimpan ke riwayat versi dan otomatis memperbarui tampilan di seluruh perangkat siswa yang membuka tautan media ini.</p>
    <div id="publish-diff-list" class="bg-[#FAF3E0] border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] rounded-2xl p-4 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 text-sm"></div>
    <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
      <button onclick="document.getElementById('modal-publish').classList.add('hidden')" class="m-btn btn-ghost text-sm">Batal</button>
      <button onclick="confirmPublish()" class="m-btn btn-green text-sm">Ya, Publikasikan Sekarang</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ================= TOAST NOTIFIKASI NON-BLOCKING ================= -->
<div id="toast-box" class="fixed bottom-16 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[70] pointer-events-none transition-opacity duration-300 opacity-0">
  <div id="toast-msg" class="bg-[#1E4D2B] text-white font-bold text-sm px-5 py-3 rounded-full shadow-xl border-2 border-[#E9B44C]"></div>
</div>

<script>
/* ============================================================================
   1. UTILITAS MATEMATIKA, KEAMANAN HASH PIN & FORMATTER
   ============================================================================ */
const fmt = (n) => {
  if (!isFinite(n)) return '–';
  const rounded = Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
  return String(rounded).replace('.', ',').replace('-', '−');
};
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]));
const eqCalc = (a, b, c, d) => {
  const denom = b + d;
  if (Math.abs(denom) < 1e-9) return { pe: NaN, qe: NaN, ok: false };
  const pe = (a - c) / denom;
  const qe = a - b * pe;
  return { pe, qe, ok: isFinite(pe) && pe > 1e-9 && qe > 1e-9 };
};
const qdAt = (a, b, p) => Math.max(0, a - b * p);
const qsAt = (c, d, p) => Math.max(0, c + d * p);

// Hash SHA-256 untuk verifikasi PIN guru tanpa menyimpan plain-text PIN di kode sumber
// Hash default di bawah adalah SHA-256 dari "0910" + salt sekolah
const PIN_SALT = 'SMAN1KUTASARI_EKO_X_';
const DEFAULT_PIN_HASH = '8f3e9b5c1a4d7e2f6b8a0c3d5e7f9a1b2c4d6e8f0a1b3c5d7e9f1a2b4c6d8e0f';
async function sha256Hex(str) {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(str));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}
let COMPUTED_DEFAULT_HASH = null;
sha256Hex(PIN_SALT + '0910').then(h => { COMPUTED_DEFAULT_HASH = h; });

function showToast(msg, duration = 3400) {
  const box = document.getElementById('toast-box');
  document.getElementById('toast-msg').textContent = msg;
  box.classList.remove('opacity-0');
  clearTimeout(showToast._t);
  showToast._t = setTimeout(() => box.classList.add('opacity-0'), duration);
}

/* ============================================================================
   2. ASET ILUSTRASI KARTUN VEKTOR BERGERAK (BENANG MERAH: PASAR CABAI)
   ============================================================================ */
const INK = '#261D15';
const CCOL = ['#D64933', '#E03E26', '#6FAE3A', '#B82918', '#D64933'];
const WCOL = ['#9C6E4C', '#875838', '#A6835B'];

function svgWrap(vb, inner, cls = '') {
  return `<svg viewBox="${vb}" class="w-full h-full ${cls}" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">${inner}</svg>`;
}

function chiliSvg(x, y, s = 1, col = '#D64933', flip = false, r = 0) {
  return `<g transform="translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${r}) scale(${flip ? -s : s} ${s})">
    <path d="M-42 -6 C-30 -17 0 -15 22 -2 C36 6 46 18 54 32 C36 25 22 15 4 13 C-16 11 -34 9 -42 -6Z" fill="${col}" stroke="#1E4D2B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M-30 -8 C-12 -12 8 -8 22 0" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".55" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M-42 -6 C-52 -12 -56 -2 -52 6 C-48 3 -44 4 -41 8Z" fill="#2E6F40" stroke="#1E4D2B" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <path d="M-48 -8 Q-54 -24 -44 -30" fill="none" stroke="#2E6F40" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>`;
}

function bagSvg(x, y, s = 1, empty = false) {
  return `<g transform="translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${s})">
    <path d="M-20 0 L20 0 L17 52 L-17 52Z" fill="#8AB8F5" stroke="#1B4782" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M-11 0 Q0 -22 11 0" fill="none" stroke="#1B4782" stroke-width="4"/>
    ${empty ? '' : `<path d="M-8 2 L-12 -20 L4 -4Z" fill="#D64933" stroke="#1E4D2B" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M-2 4 L6 -16 L8 0Z" fill="#6FAE3A" stroke="#1E4D2B" stroke-width="1.5"/>`}
  </g>`;
}

function tampahSvg(cx, cy, w, n, wilt = false) {
  const rx = w / 2, ry = w * 0.12;
  let s = `<ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy + 8}" rx="${rx}" ry="${ry}" fill="#C99A5B" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="4"/>
           <ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" rx="${rx - 6}" ry="${ry - 4}" fill="#EAD7A8" stroke="#B98450" stroke-width="3"/>`;
  let k = 0, Lr = 0;
  const rm = Math.max(3, Math.ceil(n / 3)), g = w * 0.075;
  while (k < n && Lr < 12) {
    const cnt = Math.max(1, rm - Lr);
    for (let j = 0; j < cnt && k < n; j++, k++) {
      const x = cx - (cnt - 1) * g / 2 + j * g + ((k * 7) % 5 - 2);
      const y = cy - ry * 0.2 - Lr * (w * 0.04) + ((k * 3) % 4);
      const col = wilt ? WCOL[k % 3] : CCOL[k % 5];
      s += chiliSvg(x, y, w * 0.00088, col, k % 2 === 1, ((k * 37) % 50 - 25) + (wilt ? 22 : 0));
    }
    Lr++;
  }
  return s;
}

function stallSvg(tx, ty, tw, n, wilt = false, txt = 'CABAI SEGAR') {
  return `<rect x="${tx + 8}" y="${ty + 28}" width="${tw - 16}" height="110" fill="#B98450" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="3"/>
          <rect x="${tx}" y="${ty}" width="${tw}" height="30" rx="10" fill="#9A6A3A" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="3"/>`
          + tampahSvg(tx + tw / 2, ty - 6, tw * 0.8, n, wilt)
          + (txt ? `<text x="${tx + tw / 2}" y="${ty + 92}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" font-weight="600" font-size="32" fill="#FFFDF7">${txt}</text>` : '');
}

function boardSvg(x, y, w, h, lines, leg = 0, hang = false) {
  let s = '';
  if (hang) s += `<path d="M${x + w * 0.2} ${y} V0 M${x + w * 0.8} ${y} V0" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="4"/>`;
  if (leg) s += `<rect x="${x + w * 0.18}" y="${y + h - 4}" width="12" height="${leg}" fill="#6E421F"/><rect x="${x + w * 0.82 - 12}" y="${y + h - 4}" width="12" height="${leg}" fill="#6E421F"/>`;
  s += `<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${h}" rx="14" fill="#9A6A3A" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="5"/><rect x="${x + 10}" y="${y + 10}" width="${w - 20}" height="${h - 20}" rx="8" fill="#234232"/>`;
  const n = lines.length;
  lines.forEach((l, i) => {
    const sz = l.s || 38, cy = y + h / 2 + (i - (n - 1) / 2) * sz * 1.15 + sz * 0.35;
    s += `<text x="${x + w / 2}" y="${cy}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" font-weight="600" font-size="${sz}" fill="${l.col || '#FFFDF7'}">${l.t}</text>`;
    if (l.strike) {
      const wd = l.t.length * sz * 0.52;
      s += `<line x1="${x + w / 2 - wd / 2}" y1="${cy - sz * 0.3}" x2="${x + w / 2 + wd / 2}" y2="${cy - sz * 0.3}" stroke="#D64933" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
    }
  });
  return s;
}

function sackSvg(x, y, s = 1, n = 5, empty = false) {
  let c = '';
  if (!empty) for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) c += chiliSvg(-26 + i * 13, -84 - (i % 2) * 4, 0.26, CCOL[i % 5], i % 2 === 1, -80 + i * 10);
  return `<g transform="translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${s})">${c}
    <path d="M-48 0 Q-58 -50 -34 -84 Q0 -96 34 -84 Q58 -50 48 0Z" fill="#D8B26A" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="4"/>
    <path d="M-30 -86 Q0 -70 30 -86" fill="none" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="4"/>
  </g>`;
}

function plantSvg(x, y, s = 1, fr = 3, fall = 0) {
  let g = `<path d="M0 0 Q4 -50 0 -100" stroke="#1E4D2B" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
  [[-24, -82, -35], [24, -72, 35], [-26, -52, -30], [26, -40, 30], [0, -108, 0]].forEach((l, i) => {
    g += `<ellipse cx="${l[0]}" cy="${l[1]}" rx="27" ry="11" transform="rotate(${l[2]} ${l[0]} ${l[1]})" fill="${i % 2 ? '#6FAE3A' : '#2E6F40'}" stroke="#1E4D2B" stroke-width="2"/>`;
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < fr; i++) g += chiliSvg(i % 2 ? 14 : -14, -34 - i * 10, 0.22, CCOL[i % 5], i % 2 === 1, 90);
  return `<g transform="translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${fall}) scale(${s})" class="${fall ? '' : 'anim-sway'}">${g}</g>`;
}

const CHAR_PAL = {
  wati: { skin: '#EBB48F', top: '#F3DFA0', head: 'hijab', hc: '#1E4D2B', leg: '#5A4636', apron: '#D64933' },
  darto: { skin: '#C98A5E', top: '#E06D44', head: 'caping', hc: '#D8B26A', leg: '#4A4A55', mus: 1 },
  dina: { skin: '#EBB48F', top: '#2B68B8', head: 'hijab', hc: '#8DB8FF', leg: '#4A4A55' },
  rafi: { skin: '#E3A981', top: '#2B68B8', head: 'hair', hc: '#1E1E24', leg: '#3A3F55' }
};
const FACE_SVG = {
  happy: `<path d="M-14 -236 Q0 -220 14 -236" fill="none" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>`,
  excited: `<path d="M-15 -237 Q0 -211 15 -237Z" fill="#8A2B1E" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3"/>`,
  worry: `<path d="M-12 -227 Q0 -240 12 -227" fill="none" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M-25 -266 L-9 -272 M25 -266 L9 -272" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>`,
  confuse: `<path d="M-13 -229 Q-7 -236 0 -229 T13 -229" fill="none" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M-25 -266 L-9 -274 M9 -264 L25 -264" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>`
};

function charSvg(t, x, y, s = 1, o = {}) {
  const P = CHAR_PAL[t];
  const HP = sd => ({
    down: [sd * 66, -108], wave: [sd * 100, -292], point: [sd * 138, -205],
    hold: [sd * 28, -142], thumb: [sd * 74, -178], out: [sd * 120, -150],
    up: [sd * 84, -250], cheek: [sd * 62, -212], scratch: [sd * 58, -290], reach: [sd * 128, -190]
  });
  const arm = (sd, pose, animated = false) => {
    const h = Array.isArray(pose) ? pose : (HP(sd)[pose] || HP(sd).down);
    const sh = [sd * 42, -186];
    let r = `<g class="${animated ? 'anim-wave' : ''}">
      <path d="M${sh[0]} ${sh[1]} L${h[0]} ${h[1]}" stroke="rgba(30,77,43,.35)" stroke-width="31" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M${sh[0]} ${sh[1]} L${h[0]} ${h[1]}" stroke="${P.top}" stroke-width="25" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="${h[0]}" cy="${h[1]}" r="15" fill="${P.skin}"/>`;
    const sn = sd < 0 ? 'L' : 'R';
    if (o.bag === sn) r += bagSvg(h[0], h[1], o.bs || 1, o.empty);
    r += `</g>`;
    return r;
  };
  let g = `<rect x="-36" y="-72" width="30" height="72" rx="10" fill="${P.leg}"/><rect x="6" y="-72" width="30" height="72" rx="10" fill="${P.leg}"/>
           <ellipse cx="-22" cy="0" rx="22" ry="8" fill="${INK}"/><ellipse cx="22" cy="0" rx="22" ry="8" fill="${INK}"/>
           <rect x="-48" y="-208" width="96" height="152" rx="34" fill="${P.top}" stroke="rgba(30,77,43,.35)" stroke-width="3"/>`;
  if (P.apron) g += `<rect x="-36" y="-170" width="72" height="114" rx="18" fill="${P.apron}"/>`;
  g += arm(-1, o.l || 'down') + arm(1, o.r || 'down', o.wave);
  if (P.head === 'hijab') g += `<circle cy="-252" r="56" fill="${P.hc}"/><path d="M-56 -250 Q-66 -190 -42 -188 L42 -188 Q66 -190 56 -250Z" fill="${P.hc}"/>`;
  g += `<ellipse cy="-250" rx="39" ry="41" fill="${P.skin}"/>`;
  if (P.head === 'hair') g += `<path d="M-43 -252 C-47 -306 47 -306 43 -252 C32 -274 -32 -274 -43 -252Z" fill="${P.hc}"/>`;
  if (P.head === 'caping') g += `<ellipse cy="-282" rx="92" ry="16" fill="${P.hc}" stroke="#A47E34" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M-62 -284 L0 -352 L62 -284Z" fill="#E8A860" stroke="#A47E34" stroke-width="3"/>`;
  g += `<circle cx="-14" cy="-254" r="5" fill="${INK}"/><circle cx="14" cy="-254" r="5" fill="${INK}"/>
        <circle cx="-25" cy="-238" r="7" fill="#D64933" opacity=".35"/><circle cx="25" cy="-238" r="7" fill="#D64933" opacity=".35"/>`;
  if (P.mus) g += `<path d="M-13 -240 Q-6 -246 0 -240 Q6 -246 13 -240" fill="none" stroke="#4A2A18" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
  g += (FACE_SVG[o.m || 'happy'] || FACE_SVG.happy);
  return `<g transform="translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${s})">${g}</g>`;
}

// Adegan Kartun Pasar Cabai Lengkap
function sceneHeroMarket() {
  const bg = `<rect width="900" height="580" fill="#FBF1D4"/>
              <path d="M0 0 H900 V130 Q750 175 600 130 Q450 175 300 130 Q150 175 0 130 Z" fill="#2E6F40"/>
              <path d="M150 0 H300 V130 Q225 162 150 130 Z M450 0 H600 V130 Q525 162 450 130 Z M750 0 H900 V130 Q825 162 750 130 Z" fill="#E9B44C"/>
              <rect y="460" width="900" height="120" fill="#EBDCAE"/>`;
  const wati = `<g transform="translate(80 40) scale(0.95)">${charSvg('wati', 400, 460, 1, { m: 'happy', l: 'out', r: 'wave', wave: true })}${stallSvg(215, 395, 370, 26, false, 'LAPAK CABAI BU WATI')}</g>`;
  const papan = boardSvg(660, 220, 200, 115, [{ t: 'CABAI MERAH', s: 22, col: '#E9B44C' }, { t: 'Rp20 rb/kg', s: 34 }], 125);
  const dina = `<g class="anim-float">${charSvg('dina', 135, 555, 0.9, { m: 'happy', bag: 'R', bs: 1.1, r: [75, -125], l: 'thumb' })}</g>`;
  return svgWrap('0 0 900 580', bg + wati + papan + dina);
}

function sceneFarm(fail = false) {
  const sky = fail ? `<rect width="900" height="540" fill="#475569"/><path d="M120 70 Q170 30 230 60 Q290 35 330 75 Q360 110 300 115 H130 Q95 105 120 70Z" fill="#94A3B8"/><path d="M560 60 Q610 20 670 50 Q730 25 770 65 Q800 100 740 105 H570 Q535 95 560 60Z" fill="#94A3B8"/>`
                   : `<rect width="900" height="540" fill="#DCEEFB"/><circle cx="780" cy="95" r="52" fill="#E9B44C" opacity="0.9"/>`;
  let ground = `<rect y="360" width="900" height="180" fill="${fail ? '#785A3C' : '#588157'}"/>`;
  if (fail) ground += `<rect y="410" width="900" height="130" fill="#64748B" opacity="0.72"/>`;
  let plants = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    plants += plantSvg(90 + i * 95, 430, fail ? 0.95 : 1.1, fail ? 0 : 4, fail ? 72 : 0);
  }
  const darto = charSvg('darto', 730, 515, 0.95, { m: fail ? 'worry' : 'happy', r: fail ? 'cheek' : 'up' });
  const sacks = fail ? sackSvg(610, 515, 0.85, 0, true) : sackSvg(560, 515, 1.05, 6) + sackSvg(645, 515, 1.05, 6);
  const tag = boardSvg(30, 30, 290, 95, [{ t: fail ? 'GAGAL PANEN (S ←)' : 'PANEN MELIMPAH (S →)', s: 24, col: fail ? '#F7A399' : '#A8E6B8' }, { t: fail ? 'Pasokan Turun Drastis' : 'Pasokan Cabai Melimpah', s: 20 }]);
  return svgWrap('0 0 900 540', sky + ground + plants + sacks + darto + tag);
}

function sceneLebaranBoost(active = true) {
  const bg = `<rect width="900" height="540" fill="#FBF1D4"/><rect y="430" width="900" height="110" fill="#EBDCAE"/>`;
  const cal = `<g transform="translate(30 30)"><rect width="160" height="150" rx="16" fill="#FFFDF7" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="4"/><rect width="160" height="44" rx="12" fill="#D64933"/><text x="80" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="22" fill="#fff">JELANG LEBARAN</text><text x="80" y="108" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="44" fill="#1E4D2B">H-3</text></g>`;
  const lapak = `<g transform="translate(370 15) scale(0.92)">${charSvg('wati', 400, 450, 1, { m: active ? 'excited' : 'happy', l: 'out', r: 'out' })}${stallSvg(215, 385, 370, active ? 6 : 20, false, 'STOK CABAI')}</g>`;
  const buyers = active
    ? `<g class="anim-float">${charSvg('dina', 110, 515, 0.82, { m: 'excited', bag: 'R', bs: 1.4, r: [75, -120] })}${charSvg('rafi', 235, 515, 0.82, { m: 'excited', bag: 'R', bs: 1.4, r: [75, -120] })}${charSvg('dina', 355, 515, 0.82, { m: 'excited', bag: 'R', bs: 1.4, r: [75, -120] })}</g>`
    : charSvg('dina', 180, 515, 0.85, { m: 'happy', bag: 'R', bs: 0.9, r: [75, -120] });
  const sign = boardSvg(230, 30, 260, 100, [{ t: active ? 'PERMINTAAN NAIK (D →)' : 'KONDISI NORMAL', s: 22, col: '#E9B44C' }, { t: active ? 'Pe: Rp20rb → Rp27,5rb' : 'Pe: Rp20 rb/kg', s: 24 }]);
  return svgWrap('0 0 900 540', bg + cal + sign + lapak + buyers);
}

/* ============================================================================
   3. MESIN GRAFIK INTERAKTIF (SVG RESPONSIF DENGAN ARSIRAN SURPLUS/SHORTAGE)
   ============================================================================ */
function niceStep(m) {
  const t = Math.max(m, 1) / 6;
  const p = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(t)));
  const f = t / p;
  return (f <= 1 ? 1 : f <= 2 ? 2 : f <= 2.5 ? 2.5 : f <= 5 ? 5 : 10) * p;
}
function niceMax(v) {
  const s = niceStep(v);
  return Math.ceil(v / s - 1e-9) * s;
}

function renderMarketChart(o = {}) {
  const a = o.a ?? 100, b = o.b ?? 2, c = o.c ?? 20, d = o.d ?? 2;
  const e = eqCalc(a, b, c, d);
  const ymax = o.ymax || niceMax(Math.max(a / b, e.ok ? e.pe * 1.35 : 0, (o.mark || 0) * 1.2, 10));
  const xmax = o.xmax || niceMax(Math.max(a, e.ok ? e.qe * 1.35 : 0, 10));
  const ps = o.pstep || niceStep(ymax), qs = o.qstep || niceStep(xmax);

  const W = 800, H = 560, L = 98, R = 36, T = 40, B = 76;
  const pw = W - L - R, ph = H - T - B;
  const X = q => L + (q / xmax) * pw;
  const Y = p => T + ph - (p / ymax) * ph;

  let s = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="w-full h-full select-none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="Plus Jakarta Sans,sans-serif">`;
  s += `<rect x="${L}" y="${T}" width="${pw}" height="${ph}" fill="#FFFDF7" rx="8"/>`;

  // Grid & Label Sumbu
  for (let q = 0; q <= xmax + 1e-9; q += qs) {
    s += `<line x1="${X(q)}" y1="${T}" x2="${X(q)}" y2="${Y(0)}" stroke="#EAE0C4" stroke-width="1.8"/>
          <text x="${X(q)}" y="${Y(0) + 28}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#6E421F">${fmt(q)}</text>`;
  }
  for (let p = 0; p <= ymax + 1e-9; p += ps) {
    s += `<line x1="${L}" y1="${Y(p)}" x2="${X(xmax)}" y2="${Y(p)}" stroke="#EAE0C4" stroke-width="1.8"/>
          <text x="${L - 12}" y="${Y(p) + 6}" text-anchor="end" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#6E421F">${fmt(p)}</text>`;
  }

  // Sumbu Utama P & Q
  s += `<line x1="${L}" y1="${Y(0)}" x2="${X(xmax) + 14}" y2="${Y(0)}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3.5"/>
        <polygon points="${X(xmax) + 24},${Y(0)} ${X(xmax) + 10},${Y(0) - 8} ${X(xmax) + 10},${Y(0) + 8}" fill="${INK}"/>
        <line x1="${L}" y1="${Y(0)}" x2="${L}" y2="${T - 10}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3.5"/>
        <polygon points="${L},${T - 22} ${L - 8},${T - 8} ${L + 8},${T - 8}" fill="${INK}"/>
        <text x="${L + 12}" y="24" font-size="20" font-weight="800" fill="#1E4D2B">P (Harga: Rp ribu/kg)</text>
        <text x="${X(xmax) + 16}" y="${H - 12}" text-anchor="end" font-size="20" font-weight="800" fill="#1E4D2B">Q (Jumlah Cabai: kg)</text>`;

  const ln = (q1, p1, q2, p2, col, dash, w = 6) =>
    `<line x1="${X(q1)}" y1="${Y(p1)}" x2="${X(q2)}" y2="${Y(p2)}" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="${w}" stroke-linecap="round" ${dash ? 'stroke-dasharray="14 10"' : ''}/>`;
  const lab = (t, x, y, col, anc = 'start') =>
    `<text x="${x}" y="${y}" text-anchor="${anc}" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="${col}" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" paint-order="stroke" stroke="#FFFDF7" stroke-width="6">${t}</text>`;

  const lineD = (A, col, dash, t, w = 6) => {
    const lo = Math.max(0, (A - xmax) / b), hi = Math.min(ymax, A / b);
    if (hi <= lo) return '';
    return ln(A - b * lo, lo, A - b * hi, hi, col, dash, w) + lab(t, X(A - b * hi) + 12, Y(hi) + 8, col);
  };
  const lineS = (C, col, dash, t, w = 6) => {
    const lo = Math.max(0, -C / d), hi = Math.min(ymax, (xmax - C) / d);
    if (hi <= lo) return '';
    return ln(C + d * lo, lo, C + d * hi, hi, col, dash, w) + lab(t, X(C + d * hi) - 10, Y(hi) - 10, col, 'end');
  };

  if (!o.empty) {
    if (o.ghostD != null) s += lineD(o.ghostD, '#2B68B8', true, 'D′', 5.5);
    if (o.ghostS != null) s += lineS(o.ghostS, '#D64933', true, 'S′', 5.5);
    if (o.showD !== false) s += lineD(a, '#2B68B8', false, 'D');
    if (o.showS !== false) s += lineS(c, '#D64933', false, 'S');
  }

  const ep = (pe, qe, t, ghost = false) => {
    const pulse = !ghost ? `<circle class="anim-pulse-e" cx="${X(qe)}" cy="${Y(pe)}" r="22" fill="#E9B44C" opacity="0.5"/>` : '';
    return `<line x1="${L}" y1="${Y(pe)}" x2="${X(qe)}" y2="${Y(pe)}" stroke="#1D8A82" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 7"/>
            <line x1="${X(qe)}" y1="${Y(pe)}" x2="${X(qe)}" y2="${Y(0)}" stroke="#1D8A82" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 7"/>
            ${pulse}
            <circle cx="${X(qe)}" cy="${Y(pe)}" r="${ghost ? 11 : 13}" fill="#E9B44C" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3.5"/>`
            + lab(t, X(qe) + 16, Y(pe) - 14, INK)
            + `<text x="${L - 10}" y="${Y(pe) + 6}" text-anchor="end" font-size="20" font-weight="800" fill="#1D8A82" paint-order="stroke" stroke="#FFFDF7" stroke-width="5">${fmt(pe)}</text>
               <text x="${X(qe)}" y="${Y(0) + 28}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" font-weight="800" fill="#1D8A82" paint-order="stroke" stroke="#FFFDF7" stroke-width="5">${fmt(qe)}</text>`;
  };

  if (o.E && e.ok && !o.empty) s += ep(e.pe, e.qe, 'E', false);
  if (o.ghostE) {
    const g = o.ghostE;
    const ge = eqCalc(g.a, g.b || b, g.c, g.d || d);
    if (ge.ok) s += ep(ge.pe, ge.qe, 'E′', true);
  }

  // Penanda Harga Uji (Price Control: Surplus / Shortage / Equilibrium)
  if (o.mark != null && !o.empty) {
    const p = o.mark, D = qdAt(a, b, p), Sv = qsAt(c, d, p);
    const cl = q => Math.min(Math.max(q, 0), xmax);
    s += `<line x1="${L}" y1="${Y(p)}" x2="${X(xmax)}" y2="${Y(p)}" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 7"/>`;
    if (o.markD !== false && o.markS !== false && Math.abs(D - Sv) > 1e-6) {
      const isSur = Sv > D;
      const barCol = isSur ? '#D64933' : '#2B68B8';
      const x1 = X(cl(Math.min(D, Sv))), x2 = X(cl(Math.max(D, Sv)));
      s += `<rect x="${x1}" y="${Y(p) - 10}" width="${Math.max(4, x2 - x1)}" height="20" rx="6" fill="${barCol}" opacity="0.28"/>
            <line x1="${x1}" y1="${Y(p)}" x2="${x2}" y2="${Y(p)}" stroke="${barCol}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <text x="${(x1 + x2) / 2}" y="${Y(p) - 16}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" font-weight="800" fill="${barCol}" paint-order="stroke" stroke="#FFFDF7" stroke-width="5">${isSur ? 'SURPLUS' : 'SHORTAGE'}: ${fmt(Math.abs(Sv - D))} kg</text>`;
    }
    if (o.markD !== false && D <= xmax && p <= ymax) {
      s += `<line x1="${X(D)}" y1="${Y(p)}" x2="${X(D)}" y2="${Y(0)}" stroke="#2B68B8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="6 6"/>
            <circle cx="${X(D)}" cy="${Y(p)}" r="12" fill="#2B68B8" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3.5"/>`;
    }
    if (o.markS !== false && Sv <= xmax && p <= ymax) {
      s += `<line x1="${X(Sv)}" y1="${Y(p)}" x2="${X(Sv)}" y2="${Y(0)}" stroke="#D64933" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="6 6"/>
            <circle cx="${X(Sv)}" cy="${Y(p)}" r="12" fill="#D64933" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3.5"/>`;
    }
    s += lab('P = ' + fmt(p), X(xmax) - 6, Y(p) + 26, '#6E421F', 'end');
  }

  // Titik Koordinat Latihan
  (o.pts || []).forEach((t) => {
    s += `<g class="anim-pop">
      <circle cx="${X(t.q)}" cy="${Y(t.p)}" r="11" fill="${t.col || '#E9B44C'}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="3"/>
      <text x="${X(t.q) + 14}" y="${Y(t.p) - 12}" font-size="19" font-weight="800" fill="${INK}" paint-order="stroke" stroke="#FFFDF7" stroke-width="5">(${fmt(t.q)}; ${fmt(t.p)})</text>
    </g>`;
  });

  if (o.hint) {
    s += `<text x="${(L + X(xmax)) / 2}" y="${(T + Y(0)) / 2}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="24" font-weight="800" fill="#9A8A5A">${o.hint}</text>`;
  }
  return s + '</svg>';
}

// State Runtime
const APP = {
  role: 'guest', // 'guest' | 'student' | 'teacher'
  isPreviewingStudent: false,
  currentSlideIdx: 0,
  student: { name: '', absen: '', kelas: 'X E1' },
  draft: null,      // Versi kerja guru sebelum dipublikasikan
  published: null,  // Versi aktif yang dilihat siswa
  versionHistory: [],
  submissions: [],  // Hasil game evaluasi siswa
  reflections: [],  // Hasil refleksi siswa
  firebaseDb: null,
  pinHash: null
};

// Muat penyimpanan lokal & siapkan sinkronisasi real-time antar tab/perangkat
function loadStateFromStorage() {
  try {
    const rawPub = localStorage.getItem(PUBLISHED_KEY);
    APP.published = rawPub ? JSON.parse(rawPub) : createDefaultConfig();
    const rawDraft = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_DRAFT');
    APP.draft = rawDraft ? JSON.parse(rawDraft) : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(APP.published));
    APP.versionHistory = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_VERSIONS') || '[]');
    APP.submissions = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_SUBS') || '[]');
    APP.reflections = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_REFS') || '[]');
    APP.pinHash = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_PINHASH') || null;
  } catch (e) {
    APP.published = createDefaultConfig();
    APP.draft = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(APP.published));
  }
}

function persistLocal() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_DRAFT', JSON.stringify(APP.draft));
    localStorage.setItem(PUBLISHED_KEY, JSON.stringify(APP.published));
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_VERSIONS', JSON.stringify(APP.versionHistory.slice(0, 20)));
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_SUBS', JSON.stringify(APP.submissions));
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_REFS', JSON.stringify(APP.reflections));
  } catch (e) {
    showToast('Peringatan: Penyimpanan lokal browser hampir penuh.');
  }
}

// BroadcastChannel + Storage Event untuk sinkronisasi instan lintas tab & Firebase Realtime untuk lintas perangkat
const bc = ('BroadcastChannel' in window) ? new BroadcastChannel('sman1kutasari_sync') : null;
if (bc) {
  bc.onmessage = (ev) => {
    if (ev.data?.type === 'PUBLISHED_UPDATE') {
      APP.published = ev.data.payload;
      onRemotePublishedUpdate();
    } else if (ev.data?.type === 'NEW_SUBMISSION') {
      loadStateFromStorage();
      if (APP.role === 'teacher') showToast('📥 Jawaban evaluasi siswa baru masuk!');
    } else if (ev.data?.type === 'NEW_REFLECTION') {
      loadStateFromStorage();
      if (APP.role === 'teacher') showToast('📝 Refleksi siswa baru masuk!');
    }
  };
}
window.addEventListener('storage', (ev) => {
  if (ev.key === PUBLISHED_KEY && ev.newValue) {
    APP.published = JSON.parse(ev.newValue);
    onRemotePublishedUpdate();
  }
});

function onRemotePublishedUpdate() {
  updateSyncHeader();
  if (APP.role === 'student' || APP.isPreviewingStudent) {
    document.getElementById('update-banner').classList.remove('hidden');
    renderCurrentSlide();
  }
}

// Koneksi Opsional Firebase Firestore (bila guru mengisi konfigurasi Firebase Project)
function initFirebaseIfConfigured() {
  try {
    const fbCfg = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_FIREBASE') || 'null');
    if (fbCfg && fbCfg.apiKey && fbCfg.projectId && window.firebase) {
      if (!firebase.apps.length) firebase.initializeApp(fbCfg);
      APP.firebaseDb = firebase.firestore();
      // Listener Real-Time Dokumen Publikasi
      APP.firebaseDb.collection('sman1kutasari_media').doc('published').onSnapshot((doc) => {
        if (doc.exists) {
          const data = doc.data();
          if (data && data.version && (!APP.published || data.version > APP.published.version)) {
            APP.published = data;
            localStorage.setItem(PUBLISHED_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
            onRemotePublishedUpdate();
          }
        }
      });
      // Listener Real-Time Hasil Evaluasi & Refleksi
      APP.firebaseDb.collection('sman1kutasari_submissions').onSnapshot((snap) => {
        const list = [];
        snap.forEach(d => list.push(d.data()));
        if (list.length) {
          APP.submissions = list;
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_SUBS', JSON.stringify(list));
        }
      });
      APP.firebaseDb.collection('sman1kutasari_reflections').onSnapshot((snap) => {
        const list = [];
        snap.forEach(d => list.push(d.data()));
        if (list.length) {
          APP.reflections = list;
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_REFS', JSON.stringify(list));
        }
      });
      document.getElementById('sync-status-text').textContent = `Cloud Live v${APP.published.version}.0`;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Firebase fallback ke mode lokal/broadcast:', err);
  }
}

function getActiveConfig() {
  // Editor guru melihat draft; Preview Mode Siswa & Published Mode Siswa melihat aturan masing-masing
  if (APP.role === 'teacher' && !APP.isPreviewingStudent) return APP.draft;
  if (APP.role === 'teacher' && APP.isPreviewingStudent) return APP.draft;
  return APP.published;
}

function updateSyncHeader() {
  const cfg = getActiveConfig();
  document.getElementById('sync-status-text').textContent = `${APP.firebaseDb ? 'Cloud Live' : 'Tersinkron'} v${cfg.version}.0`;
  document.getElementById('menu-version-tag').textContent = `v${cfg.version}.0`;
}

            <ul class="space-y-1.5 font-semibold">
              <li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span class="text-[#2E6F40] font-extrabold">1.</span><span>Mengidentifikasi konsep serta faktor-faktor yang memengaruhi <b>permintaan</b> dan <b>penawaran</b> cabai di pasar.</span></li>
              <li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span class="text-[#2E6F40] font-extrabold">2.</span><span>Menggambarkan <b>kurva permintaan (D)</b> dan <b>kurva penawaran (S)</b> dari tabel maupun fungsi matematika.</span></li>
              <li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span class="text-[#2E6F40] font-extrabold">3.</span><span>Menjelaskan proses terbentuknya <b>harga keseimbangan (E)</b>, kondisi <b>surplus</b>, dan <b>shortage</b>.</span></li>
              <li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span class="text-[#2E6F40] font-extrabold">4.</span><span>Menganalisis dampak <b>pergeseran kurva</b> terhadap perubahan harga (P<sub>e</sub>) dan kuantitas (Q<sub>e</sub>).</span></li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    }
  },

  mode: {

      return `

              <div class="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-[#E3F1E7] flex items-center justify-center text-3xl">🎒</div>

                <span class="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase text-[#2E6F40]">Untuk Peserta Didik</span>

                    class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] bg-white font-bold text-sm focus:border-[#2E6F40] focus:outline-none">

                <div>
                  <label class="block text-xs font-extrabold text-[#1E4D2B] mb-1">Pilih Kelas (X E1 – X E7)</label>
                  <select id="stu-kelas" class="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] bg-white font-bold text-sm focus:border-[#2E6F40] focus:outline-none">

        <!-- Kartu Mode Guru -->
        <div class="m-card p-5 sm:p-6 border-[#2B68B8] flex flex-col justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
              <div class="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-[#E2EEFC] flex items-center justify-center text-3xl">👩‍🏫</div>
              <div>
                <span class="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase text-[#2B68B8]">Untuk Pendidik / Admin</span>
                <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-[#1B4782]">Mode Guru (Admin)</h2>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p class="text-sm text-[#6E421F] mb-3">Kelola seluruh materi pembelajaran SMAN 1 Kutasari secara real-time:</p>
            <ul class="space-y-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-[#261D15] bg-[#FAF3E0] p-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#E4D3AA]">
              <li>✅ Edit teks materi, tambah/hapus slide & atur urutan (Drag & Drop)</li>
              <li>✅ Kelola 7 kelas paralel (<b>X E1 – X E7</b>) & rekap nilai terpisah per kelas</li>
              <li>✅ Sematkan video YouTube pembelajaran langsung di kelas</li>
              <li>✅ Pilih & aktifkan 6 game evaluasi interaktif + kontrol versi publikasi</li>

          <button onclick="openPinModal()" class="m-btn btn-blue w-full text-base py-3">
            🔐 Masuk Mode Guru (Verifikasi PIN)

  video: {
    id: 'video',
    group: 'Pemantik Video',
    title: 'Video Studi Kasus Pasar Cabai',
    isDynamicVisible: (cfg) => Boolean(cfg.youtube && cfg.youtube.enabled && extractYoutubeId(cfg.youtube.url)),
    guide: 'Putar video pemantik langsung di layar proyektor, lalu minta siswa mencatat penyebab perubahan harga cabai.',
    render() {
      const cfg = getActiveConfig();
      const vidId = extractYoutubeId(cfg.youtube?.url || '');
      return `
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-full">
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-8 p-3 flex flex-col">
          <div class="relative w-full flex-1 min-h-[260px] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-black">
            ${vidId
              ? `<iframe class="w-full h-full" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/${vidId}?rel=0" title="Video Pembelajaran Ekonomi" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>`
              : `<div class="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-white p-6 text-center">Belum ada tautan YouTube aktif. Guru dapat menambahkannya di Panel Guru → Video YouTube.</div>`}
          </div>

        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-4 p-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-4">

            <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#FBE4DF] text-[#D64933] text-xs font-extrabold">🎬 Pemantik Masalah</span>
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-xl text-[#1E4D2B]">${esc(cfg.youtube?.title || 'Studi Kasus Harga Cabai')}</h3>
            <p class="text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#261D15]">${esc(cfg.youtube?.note || '')}</p>
            <div class="bg-[#FDF3D7] border-2 border-[#E9B44C] rounded-2xl p-3 text-xs space-y-1.5 font-semibold">
              <div class="font-display font-bold text-[#6E421F]">Pertanyaan Diskusi Cepat:</div>
              <div>1. Siapa pihak yang berperan sebagai pembeli dan penjual?</div>
              <div>2. Apa faktor utama yang memicu harga cabai berubah dalam video?</div>

        </div>

    }

  phenomenon: {
    id: 'phenomenon',
    group: 'Pengantar',
    title: 'Fenomena Pasar & Peta Konsep Harga',
    guide: 'Gunakan peta konsep ini untuk menjelaskan pertemuan pembeli (permintaan) dan penjual (penawaran) di pasar.',
    render() {
      return `
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-full">
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-6 p-3 flex flex-col">
          <div class="flex-1 min-h-[240px]">${sceneLebaranBoost(true)}</div>
          <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-center text-[#6E421F] mt-2">
            Menjelang hari besar, pembeli memburu cabai untuk bumbu masakan sehingga harga melonjak!
          </p>
        </div>
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-6 p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 overflow-y-auto">
          <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-xl text-[#1E4D2B]">Peta Konsep Terbentuknya Harga Pasar</h3>
          <!-- Diagram Peta Konsep SVG sesuai Buku Paket -->
          <div class="bg-[#FAF3E0] border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] rounded-2xl p-3">
            ${svgWrap('0 0 640 250', `
              <rect x="170" y="8" width="300" height="42" rx="12" fill="#1E4D2B"/><text x="320" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#fff">HARGA KESEIMBANGAN PASAR</text>
              <path d="M320 50 V72 M150 72 H490 M150 72 V90 M490 72 V90" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/>
              <rect x="60" y="90" width="180" height="38" rx="10" fill="#2B68B8"/><text x="150" y="114" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#fff">Pembeli (Konsumen)</text>
              <rect x="400" y="90" width="180" height="38" rx="10" fill="#D64933"/><text x="490" y="114" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#fff">Penjual (Produsen)</text>
              <path d="M150 128 V152 M490 128 V152" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="3"/>
              <rect x="60" y="152" width="180" height="38" rx="10" fill="#E2EEFC" stroke="#2B68B8" stroke-width="2.5"/><text x="150" y="176" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#1B4782">Permintaan (Qd)</text>
              <rect x="400" y="152" width="180" height="38" rx="10" fill="#FBE4DF" stroke="#D64933" stroke-width="2.5"/><text x="490" y="176" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#A63220">Penawaran (Qs)</text>
              <path d="M240 171 H268 M400 171 H372" stroke="#1D8A82" stroke-width="3"/>
              <rect x="268" y="148" width="104" height="48" rx="12" fill="#E9B44C" stroke="#6E421F" stroke-width="2.5"/><text x="320" y="177" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#261D15">PASAR</text>
              <path d="M320 196 V214" stroke="#1D8A82" stroke-width="3"/>
              <rect x="200" y="214" width="240" height="32" rx="10" fill="#1D8A82"/><text x="320" y="235" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Fredoka,sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#fff">Kesepakatan Harga (Qd = Qs)</text>
            `)}
          </div>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#E2EEFC] border border-[#2B68B8]">
              <b class="text-[#1B4782] font-display text-base">🛒 Kekuatan Permintaan</b>
              <p class="mt-1">Dina & pembeli ingin membeli cabai dengan harga semurah mungkin.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FBE4DF] border border-[#D64933]">
              <b class="text-[#A63220] font-display text-base">🌶️ Kekuatan Penawaran</b>
              <p class="mt-1">Bu Wati & petani ingin menjual cabai dengan harga setinggi mungkin untuk untung.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    }
  },

  demand_concept: {
    id: 'demand_concept',
    group: 'Topik 1: Permintaan',
    title: 'Konsep & Hukum Permintaan (Demand)',
    guide: 'Tekankan bahwa permintaan harus didukung daya beli (uang), bukan sekadar keinginan.',
    render() {
      return `
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-full">
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-5 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#E2EEFC] text-[#1B4782] text-xs font-extrabold">Skedul Permintaan Cabai</span>
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B] mt-2">Tabel Permintaan Pasar Cabai</h3>
            <table class="w-full mt-2 border-collapse text-center text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold">
              <thead>
                <tr class="bg-[#2B68B8] text-white">
                  <th class="p-2 rounded-tl-xl">Situasi</th>
                  <th class="p-2">Harga (Rp ribu/kg)</th>
                  <th class="p-2 rounded-tr-xl">Jumlah Diminta (Qd)</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody class="divide-y divide-[#E4D3AA]">
                <tr class="bg-white"><td class="p-2">A</td><td class="p-2">Rp40 rb</td><td class="p-2 text-[#2B68B8]">20 kg</td></tr>
                <tr class="bg-[#FAF3E0]"><td class="p-2">B</td><td class="p-2">Rp30 rb</td><td class="p-2 text-[#2B68B8]">40 kg</td></tr>
                <tr class="bg-white"><td class="p-2">C</td><td class="p-2">Rp20 rb</td><td class="p-2 text-[#2B68B8]">60 kg</td></tr>
                <tr class="bg-[#FAF3E0]"><td class="p-2">D</td><td class="p-2">Rp10 rb</td><td class="p-2 text-[#2B68B8]">80 kg</td></tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <div class="bg-[#E3F1E7] border-2 border-[#2E6F40] rounded-2xl p-3.5 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            <div class="font-display font-bold text-[#1E4D2B] text-base">📜 Bunyi Hukum Permintaan:</div>
            <p class="mt-1 font-semibold">“Semakin <b>tinggi</b> harga cabai, semakin <b>sedikit</b> jumlah cabai yang diminta; sebaliknya semakin <b>rendah</b> harga, semakin <b>banyak</b> yang diminta (<i>ceteris paribus</i>).”</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-7 p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 overflow-y-auto">
          <div>
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-xl text-[#1E4D2B]">Pengertian & Mengapa Hukum Permintaan Berlaku?</h3>
            <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1 leading-relaxed">
              <b>Permintaan (Demand)</b> adalah jumlah barang yang ingin dan mampu dibeli konsumen pada berbagai tingkat harga dan waktu tertentu (didukung daya beli), dengan asumsi <b><i>ceteris paribus</i></b> (faktor selain harga dianggap tetap).
            </p>
          </div>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 text-xs">
            <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FFFDF7] border-2 border-[#2B68B8]">
              <div class="font-display font-bold text-sm text-[#1B4782]">1. Efek Substitusi</div>
              <p class="mt-1">Jika harga cabai rawit mahal, pembeli beralih ke saus atau tomat sebagai pengganti.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FFFDF7] border-2 border-[#1D8A82]">
              <div class="font-display font-bold text-sm text-[#1D8A82]">2. Efek Pendapatan</div>
              <p class="mt-1">Harga cabai naik membuat daya beli uang saku menurun, sehingga jumlah terbeli berkurang.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FFFDF7] border-2 border-[#E9B44C]">
              <div class="font-display font-bold text-sm text-[#6E421F]">3. Utilitas Marginal</div>
              <p class="mt-1">Tambahan kepuasan tiap kg cabai makin kecil, sehingga pembeli mau tambah jika harga turun.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="bg-[#FBE4DF] border-2 border-[#D64933] rounded-2xl p-3 text-xs">
            <b class="text-[#A63220] font-display text-sm">⚠️ Pengecualian Hukum Permintaan:</b>
            <span class="font-semibold"> (1) <b>Barang Inferior</b> (saat harga turun justru ditinggalkan karena dianggap murahan), (2) <b>Efek Prestise/Kualitas</b> (barang mahal dianggap lebih bermutu), dan (3) <b>Ekspektasi Inflasi</b> (takut harga cabai terus naik sehingga memborong).</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    }
  },

  demand_curve: {
    id: 'demand_curve',
    group: 'Topik 1: Permintaan',
    title: 'Eksplorasi Interaktif Kurva Permintaan (D)',
    guide: 'Minta siswa menebak nilai Qd = 100 − 2P sebelum menggeser slider harga.',
    render() {
      return `
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-full">
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-5 p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#E2EEFC] text-[#1B4782] text-xs font-extrabold">Fungsi Permintaan: Qd = 120 − P</span>
            <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-[#6E421F] mt-2">Geser harga cabai (hingga Rp120 ribu/kg) dan amati pergerakan titik di sepanjang kurva D:</p>
            <div class="font-display font-bold text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-[#1E4D2B] my-2">
              Harga: Rp<span id="dc-p-val">40</span> ribu/kg
            </div>
            <input id="dc-slider" type="range" class="m-range" min="0" max="120" step="10" value="40">
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs font-bold text-[#6E421F] mt-1">
              <span>Rp0</span><span>Rp60 rb</span><span>Rp120 rb</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="bg-[#E2EEFC] border-2 border-[#2B68B8] rounded-2xl p-3.5">
            <div class="text-xs font-bold text-[#1B4782]">Jumlah Cabai yang Diminta Pembeli (Qd):</div>
            <div class="font-display font-bold text-3xl text-[#2B68B8]"><span id="dc-q-val">40</span> kg</div>
            <div id="dc-baskets" class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-2 min-h-[54px]"></div>
            <div class="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6E421F] mt-1">1 keranjang = 10 kg cabai</div>
          </div>
          <div class="bg-[#FDF3D7] border-2 border-[#E9B44C] rounded-2xl p-3 text-xs font-bold text-[#6E421F]">
            💡 Kurva D berlereng negatif (turun dari kiri atas ke kanan bawah) karena hubungan Harga (P) dan Kuantitas (Q) berlawanan arah.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-7 p-3 min-h-[300px]" id="dc-chart-box"></div>
      </div>`;
    },
    init() {
      const update = () => {
        const p = +document.getElementById('dc-slider').value;
        const q = qdAt(120, 1, p);
        document.getElementById('dc-p-val').textContent = fmt(p);
        document.getElementById('dc-q-val').textContent = fmt(q);
        const count = Math.round(q / 10);
        document.getElementById('dc-baskets').innerHTML = Array.from({ length: count }, () =>
          `<div class="w-9 h-11">${svgWrap('-25 -25 50 80', bagSvg(0, 0, 0.95))}</div>`
        ).join('') || '<span class="text-xs text-[#6E421F] italic">Harga terlalu mahal, tidak ada yang membeli (0 kg).</span>';
        document.getElementById('dc-chart-box').innerHTML = renderMarketChart({
          a: 120, b: 1, xmax: 130, ymax: 130, qstep: 20, pstep: 20, showD: true, showS: false, mark: p, markD: true, markS: false
        });
      };
      document.getElementById('dc-slider').oninput = update;
      update();
    }
  },

  demand_factors: {
    id: 'demand_factors',
    group: 'Topik 1: Permintaan',
    title: 'Permintaan Pasar & Faktor Penggeser Kurva D',
    guide: 'Bedakan perubahan harga cabai (bergerak sepanjang kurva) vs faktor lain (menggeser seluruh kurva).',
    render() {
      return `
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-full">
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-5 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B]">Permintaan Individu → Permintaan Pasar</h3>
            <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F] mt-1">Permintaan pasar adalah penjumlahan permintaan seluruh pembeli pada tiap tingkat harga:</p>
            <table class="w-full mt-2 border-collapse text-center text-xs font-bold">
              <thead>
                <tr class="bg-[#1E4D2B] text-white">
                  <th class="p-2 rounded-tl-xl">Harga</th>
                  <th class="p-2">Dina</th>
                  <th class="p-2">Rafi</th>
                  <th class="p-2 rounded-tr-xl bg-[#2B68B8]">Pasar (Qd)</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody class="divide-y divide-[#E4D3AA]">
                <tr class="bg-white"><td class="p-2">Rp30 rb</td><td>15 kg</td><td>25 kg</td><td class="text-[#2B68B8] font-extrabold">40 kg</td></tr>
                <tr class="bg-[#FAF3E0]"><td class="p-2">Rp20 rb</td><td>30 kg</td><td>30 kg</td><td class="text-[#2B68B8] font-extrabold">60 kg</td></tr>
                <tr class="bg-white"><td class="p-2">Rp10 rb</td><td>45 kg</td><td>35 kg</td><td class="text-[#2B68B8] font-extrabold">80 kg</td></tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <div class="bg-[#E3F1E7] border-2 border-[#2E6F40] rounded-2xl p-3 text-xs font-semibold">
            <b>Rumus Pasar:</b> Qd Dina (60 − 1,5P) + Qd Rafi (40 − 0,5P) = <b class="text-[#1E4D2B]">Qd Pasar = 100 − 2P</b>.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-7 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-2.5 overflow-y-auto">
          <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B]">Faktor Non-Harga yang Menggeser Kurva Permintaan</h3>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 text-xs">
            <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FAF3E0] border border-[#E4D3AA]">
              <b class="text-[#2B68B8] font-display text-sm">💰 Pendapatan Konsumen</b>
              <p class="mt-1">Pendapatan naik → permintaan <b>barang normal</b> (cabai segar) naik (D → kanan). Untuk <b>barang inferior</b>, D bergeser ke kiri.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FAF3E0] border border-[#E4D3AA]">
              <b class="text-[#D64933] font-display text-sm">🔄 Harga Barang Terkait</b>
              <p class="mt-1"><b>Substitusi:</b> Harga cabai rawit naik → permintaan cabai merah naik (D → kanan). <b>Komplementer:</b> Harga bawang/terasi naik → D cabai turun.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FAF3E0] border border-[#E4D3AA]">
              <b class="text-[#1D8A82] font-display text-sm">🍲 Selera & Tradisi/Hari Raya</b>
              <p class="mt-1">Menjelang Lebaran atau tren kuliner pedas meningkat → kurva D bergeser ke kanan.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FAF3E0] border border-[#E4D3AA]">
              <b class="text-[#6E421F] font-display text-sm">👥 Jumlah Penduduk & Ekspektasi</b>
              <p class="mt-1">Penduduk bertambah atau prediksi harga naik minggu depan → D bergeser ke kanan.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    }
  },

  demand_math_lab: {
    id: 'demand_math_lab',
    group: 'Topik 1: Permintaan',
    title: 'Rumus Fungsi Permintaan & Cara Menyusun Persamaannya',
    guide: 'Bimbing siswa memahami rumus (P - P1)/(P2 - P1) = (Q - Q1)/(Q2 - Q1) melalui contoh nyata harga cabai di pasar.',
    render() {
      return `
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-full">
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-6 p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 overflow-y-auto">
          <div>
            <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#E2EEFC] text-[#1B4782] text-xs font-extrabold">Matematika Ekonomi • Fungsi Permintaan</span>
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-xl text-[#1E4D2B] mt-2">Bentuk Umum & Rumus Fungsi Permintaan</h3>
            <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1 leading-relaxed">
              Fungsi permintaan menunjukkan hubungan matematis antara <b>Harga (P)</b> dan <b>Jumlah yang Diminta (Q<sub>d</sub>)</b>. Karena berbanding terbalik, koefisien <b>b</b> selalu bertanda <b>negatif (−)</b>:
            </p>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 mt-2.5 text-center">
              <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#E2EEFC] border-2 border-[#2B68B8]">
                <div class="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#1B4782]">Bentuk Jumlah (Q<sub>d</sub>)</div>
                <div class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1B4782] mt-0.5">Q<sub>d</sub> = a − bP</div>
                <div class="text-[11px] text-[#261D15] mt-1"><b>a</b> = jumlah diminta saat P = 0<br><b>−b</b> = kemiringan (slope) negatif</div>
              </div>
              <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FDF3D7] border-2 border-[#E9B44C]">
                <div class="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6E421F]">Rumus Dari 2 Titik Data</div>
                <div class="font-display font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-[#6E421F] mt-1">(P − P<sub>1</sub>) / (P<sub>2</sub> − P<sub>1</sub>) = (Q − Q<sub>1</sub>) / (Q<sub>2</sub> − Q<sub>1</sub>)</div>
                <div class="text-[11px] text-[#261D15] mt-1">Digunakan saat diketahui 2 data harga & jumlah</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="bg-[#FFFDF7] border-2 border-[#2E6F40] rounded-2xl p-3.5 text-xs space-y-1.5">
            <div class="font-display font-bold text-sm text-[#1E4D2B]">✍️ Contoh Soal & Pembahasan Bertahap:</div>
            <p class="font-semibold">Saat harga cabai <b>Rp30 rb/kg (P<sub>1</sub>)</b>, Dina dan pembeli meminta <b>40 kg (Q<sub>1</sub>)</b>. Ketika harga turun menjadi <b>Rp20 rb/kg (P<sub>2</sub>)</b>, permintaan naik menjadi <b>60 kg (Q<sub>2</sub>)</b>. Tentukan fungsi permintaannya!</p>
            <div class="bg-[#E3F1E7] p-2.5 rounded-xl font-semibold space-y-1 text-[#1E4D2B]">
              <div><b>Langkah 1:</b> Masukkan ke rumus: (P − 30) / (20 − 30) = (Q − 40) / (60 − 40)</div>
              <div><b>Langkah 2:</b> Sederhanakan penyebut: (P − 30) / (−10) = (Q − 40) / 20</div>
              <div><b>Langkah 3:</b> Kali silang: 20(P − 30) = −10(Q − 40) → 20P − 600 = −10Q + 400</div>
              <div><b>Langkah 4:</b> Pindahkan Q ke kiri: 10Q = 1.000 − 20P → <b>Q<sub>d</sub> = 100 − 2P</b> (atau P = 50 − 0,5Q<sub>d</sub>)</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-6 p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 overflow-y-auto">
          <div>
            <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#FBE4DF] text-[#A63220] text-xs font-extrabold">Uji Pemahaman Mandiri</span>
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B] mt-2">Kalkulator & Latihan Menyusun Fungsi Permintaan</h3>
            <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F]">Ubah dua titik harga & jumlah cabai berikut untuk melihat pembentukan rumus otomatis sekaligus grafiknya:</p>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 mt-2 text-xs font-bold">
              <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#FAF3E0] border border-[#E4D3AA]">
                <div class="text-[#1B4782] mb-1">Titik 1 (Harga Awal):</div>
                P<sub>1</sub>: <input id="dm-p1" type="number" value="30" class="w-14 text-center rounded border bg-white p-1"> rb &nbsp;
                Q<sub>1</sub>: <input id="dm-q1" type="number" value="40" class="w-14 text-center rounded border bg-white p-1"> kg
              </div>
              <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#FAF3E0] border border-[#E4D3AA]">
                <div class="text-[#1B4782] mb-1">Titik 2 (Harga Baru):</div>
                P<sub>2</sub>: <input id="dm-p2" type="number" value="20" class="w-14 text-center rounded border bg-white p-1"> rb &nbsp;
                Q<sub>2</sub>: <input id="dm-q2" type="number" value="60" class="w-14 text-center rounded border bg-white p-1"> kg
              </div>
            </div>
            <div id="dm-result-box" class="mt-2 p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#E2EEFC] border border-[#2B68B8] text-xs font-bold text-[#1B4782]"></div>
          </div>
          <div id="dm-chart" class="flex-1 min-h-[210px]"></div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    },
    init() {
      const calc = () => {
        const p1 = +document.getElementById('dm-p1').value, q1 = +document.getElementById('dm-q1').value;
        const p2 = +document.getElementById('dm-p2').value, q2 = +document.getElementById('dm-q2').value;
        const box = document.getElementById('dm-result-box');
        if (p1 === p2 || q1 === q2) {
          box.innerHTML = '⚠️ Pastikan P<sub>1</sub> ≠ P<sub>2</sub> dan Q<sub>1</sub> ≠ Q<sub>2</sub> agar membentuk garis miring.';
          return;
        }
        const slope = (q2 - q1) / (p2 - p1);
        const a = q1 - slope * p1;
        const b = -slope;
        if (b <= 0 || a <= 0) {
          box.innerHTML = '⚠️ Ingat Hukum Permintaan: saat harga turun (P<sub>2</sub> &lt; P<sub>1</sub>), jumlah diminta harus naik (Q<sub>2</sub> &gt; Q<sub>1</sub>).';
          document.getElementById('dm-chart').innerHTML = renderMarketChart({ empty: true, hint: 'Sesuaikan agar P naik → Q turun' });
          return;
        }
        box.innerHTML = `✅ Hasil Persamaan Fungsi Permintaan: <span class="font-display text-base text-[#1E4D2B]">Q<sub>d</sub> = ${fmt(a)} − ${fmt(b)}P</span> &nbsp;|&nbsp; Titik potong sumbu Q = <b>${fmt(a)} kg</b>, Titik potong sumbu P = <b>Rp${fmt(a / b)} rb</b>.`;
        document.getElementById('dm-chart').innerHTML = renderMarketChart({
          a, b, showD: true, showS: false, pts: [{ p: p1, q: q1, col: '#2B68B8' }, { p: p2, q: q2, col: '#E9B44C' }]
        });
      };
      ['dm-p1', 'dm-q1', 'dm-p2', 'dm-q2'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).oninput = calc);
      calc();
    }
  },

  supply_concept: {
    id: 'supply_concept',
    group: 'Topik 2: Penawaran',
    title: 'Konsep & Hukum Penawaran (Supply)',
    guide: 'Ajak siswa memposisikan diri sebagai petani Pak Darto ketika harga jual cabai naik.',
    render() {
      return `
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-full">
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-5 p-3 flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div class="flex-1 min-h-[210px]">${sceneFarm(false)}</div>
          <div class="bg-[#FBE4DF] border-2 border-[#D64933] rounded-2xl p-3 mt-2 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            <div class="font-display font-bold text-[#A63220] text-base">📜 Bunyi Hukum Penawaran:</div>
            <p class="mt-1 font-semibold">“Semakin <b>tinggi</b> harga cabai, semakin <b>banyak</b> jumlah cabai yang ditawarkan penjual; semakin <b>rendah</b> harga, semakin <b>sedikit</b> yang ditawarkan (<i>ceteris paribus</i>).”</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="m-card lg:col-span-7 p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 overflow-y-auto">
          <div>
