const SESSION_GAME_LOCK = {}; // Mengunci 1 pilihan game per sesi siswa (kecuali allowRetry aktif)

function initGameZone() {
  const root = document.getElementById('game-zone-root');
  if (!root) return;
  const cfg = getActiveConfig();
  const gs = cfg.gameSettings || { enabled: true, allowRetry: false, timeLimitSec: 300, activeGames: [] };
  const activeList = GAMES_CATALOG.filter(g => (gs.activeGames || []).includes(g.id));

  const kelas = APP.student.kelas || 'X E1';
  const sess = (cfg.sessions[kelas] || []).find(s => s.active) || { id: 'SESI-DEFAULT' };
  const lockKey = `${APP.student.name}_${kelas}_${sess.id}`;

  // Jika siswa sudah menyelesaikan game dan allowRetry false
  if (APP.role === 'student' && SESSION_GAME_LOCK[lockKey] && !gs.allowRetry) {
    const done = SESSION_GAME_LOCK[lockKey];
    root.innerHTML = `
      <div class="m-card max-w-2xl mx-auto p-6 text-center space-y-4">
        <div class="text-5xl">🏆</div>
        <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-[#1E4D2B]">Evaluasi Game Selesai!</h3>
        <p class="text-sm text-[#6E421F]">Kamu telah menyelesaikan permainan <b>${esc(done.gameName)}</b> pada sesi ini dengan skor:</p>
        <div class="inline-block px-8 py-3 rounded-3xl bg-[#E9B44C] font-display font-bold text-4xl text-[#261D15]">${done.score} / 100</div>
        <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F]">Sesuai aturan guru, setiap siswa memainkan 1 permainan pada sesi ini. Silakan lanjut ke slide Refleksi.</p>
        <div><button onclick="goToSlideById('reflection')" class="m-btn btn-green text-sm">Lanjut ke Refleksi →</button></div>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  // Jika hanya 1 game yang diaktifkan guru, langsung mulai game tersebut tanpa dashboard pilihan
  if (activeList.length === 1) {
    launchMiniGame(activeList[0].id);
    return;
  }

  // Dashboard Pilihan 6 Game
  root.innerHTML = `
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-3 h-full">
      <div class="bg-[#FDF3D7] border-2 border-[#E9B44C] rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs sm:text-sm">
        <span>🎮 <b>Pilih 1 Permainan Evaluasi:</b> Kamu hanya dapat memilih dan menyelesaikan <b>1 game</b> pada sesi ini sebelum mengisi refleksi.</span>
        <span class="font-extrabold text-[#1E4D2B]">Peserta: ${esc(APP.student.name || 'Siswa')} (${esc(kelas)})</span>
      </div>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3.5 overflow-y-auto pb-2">
        ${activeList.map(g => `
          <div class="m-card p-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 border-2" style="border-color:${g.color}">
            <div>
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span class="text-3xl">${g.icon}</span>
                <span class="text-[11px] font-extrabold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-white" style="background:${g.color}">${g.badge}</span>
              </div>
              <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg mt-2" style="color:${g.color}">${g.name}</h3>
              <p class="text-xs text-[#261D15] mt-1 leading-relaxed">${g.desc}</p>
              <div class="mt-2 text-[11px] text-[#6E421F] bg-[#FAF3E0] p-2 rounded-xl"><b>Cara Main:</b> ${g.howTo}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[#E4D3AA]">
              <span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#6E421F]">⏱️ ${g.duration}</span>
              <button onclick="launchMiniGame('${g.id}')" class="m-btn text-xs text-white !py-1.5 !px-4" style="background:${g.color}">Mainkan →</button>
            </div>
          </div>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>`;
}

async function recordGameScore(gameObj, score, correctCount, totalCount, durationSec) {
  const cfg = getActiveConfig();
  const kelas = APP.student.kelas || 'X E1';
  const sess = (cfg.sessions[kelas] || []).find(s => s.active) || { id: 'SESI-DEFAULT', name: 'Sesi Umum' };
  const lockKey = `${APP.student.name}_${kelas}_${sess.id}`;

  const payload = {
    id: 'SUB-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
    studentName: APP.student.name || 'Siswa Tanpa Nama',
    studentAbsen: APP.student.absen || '-',
    kelas,
    sessionId: sess.id,
    sessionName: sess.name,
    gameId: gameObj.id,
    gameName: gameObj.name,
    score: Math.round(score),
    correctCount,
    totalCount,
    durationSec,
    submittedAt: new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID')
  };

  if (APP.role === 'student') {
    SESSION_GAME_LOCK[lockKey] = payload;
    APP.submissions.unshift(payload);
    persistLocal();
    if (APP.firebaseDb) {
      try {
        await APP.firebaseDb.collection('sman1kutasari_submissions').doc(payload.id).set(payload);
      } catch (e) { /* fallback tersimpan lokal */ }
    }
    if (bc) bc.postMessage({ type: 'NEW_SUBMISSION', payload });
  }
}

function launchMiniGame(gameId) {
  const root = document.getElementById('game-zone-root');
  const gameObj = GAMES_CATALOG.find(g => g.id === gameId);
  const startTime = Date.now();
  const cfg = getActiveConfig();

  const finishScreen = async (score, correct, total, summaryHtml) => {
    const dur = Math.max(5, Math.round((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000));
    await recordGameScore(gameObj, score, correct, total, dur);
    root.innerHTML = `
      <div class="m-card max-w-2xl mx-auto p-6 text-center space-y-4 anim-pop">
        <div class="text-5xl">${score >= 70 ? '🎉' : '💪'}</div>
        <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-[#1E4D2B]">${gameObj.name} Selesai!</h3>
        <div class="flex justify-center gap-4">
          <div class="px-6 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#E9B44C] font-display font-bold text-3xl">Skor: ${Math.round(score)}</div>
          <div class="px-6 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#E3F1E7] font-display font-bold text-xl text-[#1E4D2B] flex items-center">Benar ${correct}/${total} • ${dur} dtk</div>
        </div>
        <div class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-left bg-[#FAF3E0] p-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#E4D3AA]">${summaryHtml}</div>
        <div class="flex justify-center gap-3 pt-2">
          ${(APP.role === 'teacher' || cfg.gameSettings.allowRetry) ? `<button onclick="launchMiniGame('${gameId}')" class="m-btn btn-gold text-xs sm:text-sm">↺ Main Ulang</button>` : ''}
          <button onclick="goToSlideById('reflection')" class="m-btn btn-green text-xs sm:text-sm">Lanjut Isi Refleksi →</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  };

  // --- GAME 1: MARKET DETECTIVE ---
  if (gameId === 'detective') {
    const cases = [
      { clue: '📰 Berita Pasar: Menjelang Lebaran, ibu-ibu di Kutasari memborong cabai merah untuk memasak rendang.', q: 'Kurva apa yang terpengaruh dan ke mana arah pergeserannya?', opts: ['Kurva Permintaan (D) bergeser ke kanan → Pe naik, Qe naik', 'Kurva Penawaran (S) bergeser ke kiri → Pe naik, Qe turun', 'Tidak ada kurva yang bergeser'], c: 0, exp: 'Hari raya meningkatkan selera & jumlah pembeli sehingga kurva D bergeser ke kanan.' },
      { clue: '🌧️ Laporan Cuaca: Hujan deras merusak kebun cabai Pak Darto sehingga hasil panen turun 40%.', q: 'Analisis perubahan kurva dan harga keseimbangan!', opts: ['Kurva D bergeser ke kiri → Pe turun', 'Kurva S bergeser ke kiri → Pe naik, Qe turun', 'Kurva S bergeser ke kanan → Pe turun'], c: 1, exp: 'Gagal panen menurunkan pasokan sehingga kurva S bergeser ke kiri.' },
      { clue: '🚜 Inovasi Tani: Pemerintah memberikan subsidi pupuk dan bibit cabai unggul kepada petani.', q: 'Dampak kebijakan tersebut terhadap pasar cabai adalah…', opts: ['Kurva S bergeser ke kanan → Pe turun, Qe naik', 'Kurva D bergeser ke kanan → Pe naik', 'Kurva S bergeser ke kiri → Qe turun'], c: 0, exp: 'Subsidi menekan biaya produksi sehingga penawaran meningkat (S bergeser ke kanan).' },
      { clue: '🍅 Info Harga: Harga saus sambal kemasan naik drastis, sehingga warga beralih membuat sambal cabai segar.', q: 'Apa yang terjadi pada pasar cabai segar?', opts: ['Kurva D cabai segar bergeser ke kanan (substitusi)', 'Kurva S cabai segar bergeser ke kiri', 'Pergerakan sepanjang kurva S'], c: 0, exp: 'Saus sambal dan cabai segar bersifat substitusi; harga pengganti naik menggeser D cabai ke kanan.' }
    ];
    let idx = 0, ok = 0;
    const draw = () => {
      const item = cases[idx];
      root.innerHTML = `
        <div class="m-card max-w-3xl mx-auto p-5 space-y-4">
          <div class="flex justify-between items-center"><span class="font-display font-bold text-[#2B68B8]">🕵️ Market Detective • Kasus ${idx + 1}/${cases.length}</span><span class="text-xs font-bold">Skor Sementara: ${Math.round((ok / cases.length) * 100)}</span></div>
          <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#E2EEFC] border-2 border-[#2B68B8] text-sm font-bold">${item.clue}</div>
          <p class="font-extrabold text-sm">${item.q}</p>
          <div class="space-y-2">${item.opts.map((o, i) => `<button class="det-opt w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] bg-white hover:border-[#2B68B8] text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold" data-i="${i}">${o}</button>`).join('')}</div>
          <div id="det-fb" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold"></div>
        </div>`;
      document.querySelectorAll('.det-opt').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.det-opt').forEach(x => x.disabled = true);
        const right = +b.dataset.i === item.c;
        if (right) ok++;
        const fb = document.getElementById('det-fb');
        fb.classList.remove('hidden');
        fb.className = 'p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold ' + (right ? 'bg-[#E3F1E7] text-[#1E4D2B]' : 'bg-[#FBE4DF] text-[#A63220]');
        fb.innerHTML = `${right ? '✅ Investigasi Tepat! ' : '❌ Kurang Tepat. '}${item.exp} <button id="det-nx" class="m-btn btn-green !py-1 !px-3 text-xs ml-2">${idx === cases.length - 1 ? 'Lihat Hasil' : 'Kasus Berikutnya →'}</button>`;
        document.getElementById('det-nx').onclick = () => { if (idx < cases.length - 1) { idx++; draw(); } else finishScreen((ok / cases.length) * 100, ok, cases.length, `Kamu memecahkan <b>${ok} dari ${cases.length}</b> kasus investigasi pergeseran kurva pasar cabai.`); };
      });
    };
    draw();
    return;
  }

  // --- GAME 2: ECON MATCH-UP ---
  if (gameId === 'matchup') {
    const pairs = [
      { id: 1, left: 'Harga cabai naik (faktor lain tetap)', right: 'Titik bergerak naik di sepanjang kurva D' },
      { id: 2, left: 'Harga di atas harga keseimbangan (P > Pe)', right: 'Terjadi Surplus (Qs > Qd), harga turun' },
      { id: 3, left: 'Harga di bawah harga keseimbangan (P < Pe)', right: 'Terjadi Shortage (Qd > Qs), harga naik' },
      { id: 4, left: 'Biaya pupuk cabai melonjak', right: 'Kurva Penawaran (S) bergeser ke kiri' },
      { id: 5, left: 'Syarat Keseimbangan Pasar (E)', right: 'Jumlah diminta sama dengan ditawarkan (Qd = Qs)' }
    ];
    let selL = null, matched = [], wrongAttempts = 0;
    const rightShuffled = [...pairs].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
    const draw = () => {
      root.innerHTML = `
        <div class="m-card max-w-4xl mx-auto p-5 space-y-3">
          <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
            <span class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#2E6F40]">🃏 Econ Match-Up • Cocokkan Pasangan Konsep</span>
            <span class="text-xs font-bold">Cocok: ${matched.length}/${pairs.length}</span>
          </div>
          <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F]">Klik satu kartu di kolom kiri, lalu klik pasangannya di kolom kanan.</p>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div class="space-y-2">${pairs.map(p => {
              const done = matched.includes(p.id);
              return `<button ${done ? 'disabled' : ''} data-l="${p.id}" class="mu-l w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl border-2 text-xs font-bold ${done ? 'bg-[#E3F1E7] border-[#2E6F40] opacity-60' : selL === p.id ? 'bg-[#FDF3D7] border-[#E9B44C]' : 'bg-white border-[#E4D3AA]'}">${done ? '✅ ' : ''}${p.left}</button>`;
            }).join('')}</div>
            <div class="space-y-2">${rightShuffled.map(p => {
              const done = matched.includes(p.id);
              return `<button ${done ? 'disabled' : ''} data-r="${p.id}" class="mu-r w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl border-2 text-xs font-bold ${done ? 'bg-[#E3F1E7] border-[#2E6F40] opacity-60' : 'bg-white border-[#2B68B8] hover:bg-[#E2EEFC]'}">${done ? '✅ ' : ''}${p.right}</button>`;
            }).join('')}</div>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      document.querySelectorAll('.mu-l').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { selL = +b.dataset.l; draw(); });
      document.querySelectorAll('.mu-r').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
        if (!selL) { showToast('Pilih kartu di kolom kiri terlebih dahulu!'); return; }
        if (+b.dataset.r === selL) {
          matched.push(selL); selL = null;
          if (matched.length === pairs.length) {
            const sc = Math.max(50, 100 - wrongAttempts * 10);
            finishScreen(sc, pairs.length, pairs.length, `Semua 5 pasangan konsep ekonomi berhasil dicocokkan dengan ${wrongAttempts} kesalahan percobaan.`);
          } else draw();
        } else {
          wrongAttempts++; showToast('❌ Pasangan belum cocok, coba perhatikan hubungan sebab-akibatnya!');
        }
      });
    };
    draw();
    return;
  }

  // --- GAME 3: CURVE CRAFTER ---
  if (gameId === 'crafter') {
    root.innerHTML = `
      <div class="m-card max-w-3xl mx-auto p-5 space-y-4">
        <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-xl text-[#1D8A82]">📐 Curve Crafter — Studio Fungsi ke Keseimbangan</h3>
        <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm">Diketahui pasar cabai: <b>Qd = 80 − 2P</b> dan <b>Qs = 20 + 2P</b>. Lengkapi 4 nilai berikut untuk membentuk kurva dan titik keseimbangan:</p>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs font-bold">
          <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#E2EEFC] border border-[#2B68B8]">1. Saat P = 10, berapa Qd = 80 − 2(10)? <input id="cc-1" type="number" class="mt-1 w-full p-2 rounded-xl border bg-white text-center text-base"></div>
          <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FBE4DF] border border-[#D64933]">2. Saat P = 10, berapa Qs = 20 + 2(10)? <input id="cc-2" type="number" class="mt-1 w-full p-2 rounded-xl border bg-white text-center text-base"></div>
          <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FDF3D7] border border-[#E9B44C]">3. Berapa Harga Keseimbangan (Pe)? <input id="cc-3" type="number" class="mt-1 w-full p-2 rounded-xl border bg-white text-center text-base"></div>
          <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#E3F1E7] border border-[#2E6F40]">4. Berapa Jumlah Keseimbangan (Qe)? <input id="cc-4" type="number" class="mt-1 w-full p-2 rounded-xl border bg-white text-center text-base"></div>
        </div>
        <button id="cc-submit" class="m-btn btn-green w-full text-sm">Periksa & Selesaikan Studio Kurva</button>
      </div>`;
    document.getElementById('cc-submit').onclick = () => {
      const ans = [+document.getElementById('cc-1').value, +document.getElementById('cc-2').value, +document.getElementById('cc-3').value, +document.getElementById('cc-4').value];
      const key = [60, 40, 15, 50];
      const ok = ans.filter((v, i) => Math.abs(v - key[i]) < 0.1).length;
      finishScreen((ok / 4) * 100, ok, 4, `Kunci jawaban: (1) Qd = 60 kg, (2) Qs = 40 kg, (3) Pe = Rp15 ribu/kg, (4) Qe = 50 kg.`);
    };
    return;
  }

  // --- GAME 4: MARKET TYCOON ---
  if (gameId === 'tycoon') {
    const scenarios = [
      { sit: 'Lapak cabaimu memiliki stok 90 kg, sedangkan pada harga Rp35 rb/kg pembeli hanya mau membeli 30 kg (Surplus 60 kg, cabai mulai layu).', q: 'Keputusan terbaik sebagai pengelola lapak adalah…', opts: ['Menurunkan harga bertahap menuju Rp20 rb/kg agar stok habis', 'Menaikkan harga menjadi Rp45 rb/kg', 'Menimbun cabai sampai busuk'], c: 0 },
      { sit: 'Harga cabai di lapak Rp12 rb/kg. Pembeli mengantre meminta 76 kg, sementara stok tersedia hanya 44 kg (Shortage 32 kg).', q: 'Langkah rasional apa yang terjadi di pasar?', opts: ['Menurunkan harga lagi menjadi Rp5 rb', 'Menaikkan harga menuju titik keseimbangan agar permintaan & pasokan seimbang', 'Menutup lapak selamanya'], c: 1 },
      { sit: 'Biaya angkut & pupuk cabai naik. Kurva penawaran bergeser ke kiri.', q: 'Bagaimana dampak pada harga keseimbangan baru di lapakmu?', opts: ['Harga keseimbangan naik dan jumlah transaksi berkurang', 'Harga turun drastis', 'Tidak berpengaruh sama sekali'], c: 0 }
    ];
    let idx = 0, ok = 0;
    const draw = () => {
      const sc = scenarios[idx];
      root.innerHTML = `
        <div class="m-card max-w-3xl mx-auto p-5 space-y-4">
          <span class="font-display font-bold text-[#D64933]">🏪 Market Tycoon • Keputusan ${idx + 1}/${scenarios.length}</span>
          <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#FDF3D7] border-2 border-[#E9B44C] text-sm font-bold">${sc.sit}</div>
          <p class="text-sm font-extrabold">${sc.q}</p>
          <div class="space-y-2">${sc.opts.map((o, i) => `<button class="ty-o w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] bg-white hover:border-[#D64933] text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold" data-i="${i}">${o}</button>`).join('')}</div>
        </div>`;
      document.querySelectorAll('.ty-o').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
        if (+b.dataset.i === sc.c) ok++;
        if (idx < scenarios.length - 1) { idx++; draw(); }
        else finishScreen((ok / scenarios.length) * 100, ok, scenarios.length, `Kamu mengambil <b>${ok} dari ${scenarios.length}</b> keputusan ekonomi pasar yang tepat.`);
      });
    };
    draw();
    return;
  }

  // --- GAME 5: PRICE QUEST ---
  if (gameId === 'quest') {
    const posts = [
      { pos: 'Pos 1: Hukum Permintaan', q: 'Jika harga cabai turun dari Rp30 rb ke Rp20 rb, maka jumlah cabai yang diminta akan…', opts: ['Naik', 'Turun'], c: 0 },
      { pos: 'Pos 2: Hukum Penawaran', q: 'Jika harga cabai naik dari Rp20 rb ke Rp40 rb, maka jumlah cabai yang ditawarkan petani akan…', opts: ['Turun', 'Naik'], c: 1 },
      { pos: 'Pos 3: Bentuk Kurva', q: 'Kurva permintaan (D) selalu digambarkan miring dari…', opts: ['Kiri atas ke kanan bawah', 'Kiri bawah ke kanan atas'], c: 0 },
      { pos: 'Pos 4: Fungsi Pasar', q: 'Pada Qd = 60 − 2P, jika P = 10 maka Qd = …', opts: ['40 kg', '20 kg'], c: 0 },
      { pos: 'Pos 5: Titik Keseimbangan', q: 'Keseimbangan pasar tercapai apabila…', opts: ['Qd = Qs', 'Qd > Qs'], c: 0 }
    ];
    let idx = 0, ok = 0;
    const draw = () => {
      const p = posts[idx];
      root.innerHTML = `
        <div class="m-card max-w-2xl mx-auto p-5 space-y-4">
          <div class="flex gap-1.5">${posts.map((_, i) => `<span class="flex-1 h-2.5 rounded-full ${i <= idx ? 'bg-[#E9B44C]' : 'bg-[#E4D3AA]'}"></span>`).join('')}</div>
          <span class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#B8841E]">🗺️ ${p.pos}</span>
          <p class="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold">${p.q}</p>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">${p.opts.map((o, i) => `<button class="pq-o p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] bg-white hover:border-[#2E6F40] font-display font-bold text-base" data-i="${i}">${o}</button>`).join('')}</div>
        </div>`;
      document.querySelectorAll('.pq-o').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
        if (+b.dataset.i === p.c) ok++;
        if (idx < posts.length - 1) { idx++; draw(); }
        else finishScreen((ok / posts.length) * 100, ok, posts.length, `Selamat! Kamu menaklukkan 5 pos petualangan Price Quest dengan ${ok} jawaban benar.`);
      });
    };
    draw();
    return;
  }

  // --- GAME 6: ECONOMIC BRAIN BATTLE (MENGGUNAKAN BANK SOAL GURU) ---
  const bank = (cfg.quizBank && cfg.quizBank.length) ? cfg.quizBank : createDefaultConfig().quizBank;
  let idx = 0, ok = 0;
  const drawBattle = () => {
    const item = bank[idx];
    root.innerHTML = `
      <div class="m-card max-w-3xl mx-auto p-5 space-y-4">
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
          <span class="font-display font-bold text-[#6E421F]">⚡ Economic Brain Battle • Soal ${idx + 1}/${bank.length}</span>
          <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#E3F1E7] text-xs font-extrabold text-[#1E4D2B]">Benar: ${ok}</span>
        </div>
        <p class="text-sm sm:text-base font-extrabold leading-snug">${esc(item.q)}</p>
        <div class="space-y-2">${item.o.map((opt, i) => `<button class="bb-o w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] bg-white hover:border-[#2E6F40] text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold" data-i="${i}">${'ABCDE'[i]}. ${esc(opt)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
        <div id="bb-fb" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold"></div>
      </div>`;
    document.querySelectorAll('.bb-o').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.bb-o').forEach(x => x.disabled = true);
      const right = +b.dataset.i === item.c;
      if (right) ok++;
      const fb = document.getElementById('bb-fb');
      fb.classList.remove('hidden');
      fb.className = 'p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold ' + (right ? 'bg-[#E3F1E7] text-[#1E4D2B]' : 'bg-[#FBE4DF] text-[#A63220]');
      fb.innerHTML = `${right ? '✅ Benar! ' : '❌ Keliru. '}${esc(item.e || '')} <button id="bb-nx" class="m-btn btn-green !py-1 !px-3 text-xs ml-2">${idx === bank.length - 1 ? 'Selesai & Lihat Nilai' : 'Lanjut →'}</button>`;
      document.getElementById('bb-nx').onclick = () => {
        if (idx < bank.length - 1) { idx++; drawBattle(); }
        else finishScreen((ok / bank.length) * 100, ok, bank.length, `Kamu menjawab benar <b>${ok} dari ${bank.length}</b> soal dari Bank Soal Guru.`);
      };
    });
  };
  drawBattle();
}

/* ============================================================================
   7. NAVIGASI SLIDE, MENU OTOMATIS & RENDERER DINAMIS
   ============================================================================ */
function getVisibleSlides() {
  const cfg = getActiveConfig();
  const list = [];
  (cfg.slideOrder || []).forEach(id => {
    let slide = BASE_SLIDES[id] || (cfg.customSlides || []).find(s => s.id === id);
    if (!slide) return;
    // Cek visibilitas dinamis pada mode siswa / pratinjau siswa (misal slide Video otomatis hilang jika kosong)
    const isStudentView = (APP.role === 'student' || APP.isPreviewingStudent);
    if (isStudentView && typeof slide.isDynamicVisible === 'function' && !slide.isDynamicVisible(cfg)) {
      return;
    }
    const ov = (cfg.slideOverrides || {})[id] || {};
    list.push({
      ...slide,
      title: ov.title || slide.title,
      guide: ov.guide || slide.guide,
      customBody: ov.customBody || slide.customBody || ''
    });
  });
  return list;
}

function goToSlide(idx) {
  const slides = getVisibleSlides();
  if (!slides.length) return;
  APP.currentSlideIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(slides.length - 1, idx));
  renderCurrentSlide();
}

function goToSlideById(id) {
  const slides = getVisibleSlides();
  const idx = slides.findIndex(s => s.id === id);
  if (idx >= 0) goToSlide(idx);
}

function renderCurrentSlide() {
  const slides = getVisibleSlides();
  if (APP.currentSlideIdx >= slides.length) APP.currentSlideIdx = Math.max(0, slides.length - 1);
  const s = slides[APP.currentSlideIdx];
  if (!s) return;

  document.getElementById('slide-counter').textContent = `${APP.currentSlideIdx + 1} / ${slides.length}`;
  document.getElementById('slide-mobile-pos').textContent = `${APP.currentSlideIdx + 1} / ${slides.length}`;
  document.getElementById('slide-group-badge').textContent = s.group || 'Materi Ekonomi';
  document.getElementById('slide-title').textContent = s.title;

  // Render Isi Slide (atau konten kustom buatan guru)
  const bodyEl = document.getElementById('slide-body');
  if (s.render) {
    bodyEl.innerHTML = s.render();
    if (s.customBody) {
      bodyEl.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div class="mt-3 m-card p-4 bg-[#FDF3D7] border-[#E9B44C] text-sm font-semibold">${esc(s.customBody).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>`);
    }
    if (s.init) s.init();
  } else {
    bodyEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="m-card max-w-4xl mx-auto p-6 space-y-4 h-full overflow-y-auto">
        <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#E3F1E7] text-[#1E4D2B] text-xs font-extrabold">${esc(s.group || 'Materi Tambahan Guru')}</span>
        <h2 class="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-[#1E4D2B]">${esc(s.title)}</h2>
        <div class="text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">${esc(s.customBody)}</div>
      </div>`;
  }

  // Panduan Guru (hanya muncul di mode guru & bukan pratinjau siswa)
  const showTeacherTools = APP.role === 'teacher' && !APP.isPreviewingStudent;
  document.getElementById('teacher-guide-box').classList.toggle('hidden', !showTeacherTools);
  document.getElementById('slide-teacher-quick').classList.toggle('hidden', !showTeacherTools);
  if (showTeacherTools) {
    document.getElementById('teacher-guide-text').textContent = s.guide || 'Jelaskan konsep ini dengan contoh pasar cabai.';
  }

  // Footer Navigasi
  document.getElementById('btn-prev').disabled = APP.currentSlideIdx === 0;
  document.getElementById('btn-next-label').textContent = APP.currentSlideIdx === slides.length - 1 ? 'Selesai (Ke Beranda)' : 'Lanjut';
  document.getElementById('slide-dots').innerHTML = slides.map((item, i) => `
    <button onclick="goToSlide(${i})" title="${esc(item.title)}"
      class="h-2.5 rounded-full transition-all ${i === APP.currentSlideIdx ? 'w-7 bg-[#2E6F40]' : 'w-2.5 bg-[#D4C090] hover:bg-[#6E421F]'}"></button>
  `).join('');

  buildMenuList();
  document.getElementById('slide-viewport').scrollTop = 0;
}

function buildMenuList() {
  const slides = getVisibleSlides();
  let lastGrp = '';
  document.getElementById('menu-list').innerHTML = slides.map((s, i) => {
    const grpHeader = s.group !== lastGrp ? `<div class="text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#2E6F40] bg-[#E3F1E7] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg mt-2 mb-1">${esc(s.group)}</div>` : '';
    lastGrp = s.group;
    return grpHeader + `
      <button onclick="goToSlide(${i}); document.getElementById('menu-drawer').classList.add('hidden');"
        class="w-full text-left px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition ${i === APP.currentSlideIdx ? 'bg-[#E9B44C] text-[#261D15]' : 'hover:bg-[#FAF3E0]'}">
        <span class="w-5 text-center font-display text-[#6E421F]">${i + 1}.</span>
        <span class="truncate">${esc(s.title)}</span>
      </button>`;
  }).join('');
}

/* ============================================================================
   8. PEMILIHAN MODE (SISWA vs GURU) & AUTENTIKASI PIN RAHASIA
   ============================================================================ */
function enterStudentMode() {
  const name = (document.getElementById('stu-name')?.value || '').trim();
  const absen = (document.getElementById('stu-absen')?.value || '').trim();
  const kelas = document.getElementById('stu-kelas')?.value || 'X E1';
  if (!name) {
    showToast('Mohon tuliskan nama lengkapmu terlebih dahulu!');
    return;
  }
  APP.role = 'student';
  APP.isPreviewingStudent = false;
  APP.student = { name, absen: absen || '-', kelas };

  document.getElementById('mode-badge-icon').textContent = '🎒';
  document.getElementById('mode-badge-text').textContent = 'Mode Siswa';
  document.getElementById('btn-open-admin').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('student-chip').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('student-chip-label').textContent = `${name} • ${kelas}`;

  showToast(`Selamat belajar, ${name} (${kelas})!`);
  // Lompat ke slide materi pertama setelah pemilihan mode
  const slides = getVisibleSlides();
  const nextIdx = Math.min(slides.length - 1, APP.currentSlideIdx + 1);
  goToSlide(nextIdx);
}

function openPinModal() {
  document.getElementById('input-guru-pin').value = '';
  document.getElementById('pin-error-msg').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('modal-pin').classList.remove('hidden');
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('input-guru-pin').focus(), 60);
}

function closePinModal() {
  document.getElementById('modal-pin').classList.add('hidden');
}

async function verifyGuruPin() {
  const raw = document.getElementById('input-guru-pin').value.trim();
  const hashed = await sha256Hex(PIN_SALT + raw);
  const validHash = APP.pinHash || COMPUTED_DEFAULT_HASH;
  if (hashed === validHash) {
    closePinModal();
    APP.role = 'teacher';
    APP.isPreviewingStudent = false;
    document.getElementById('mode-badge-icon').textContent = '👩‍🏫';
    document.getElementById('mode-badge-text').textContent = 'Mode Guru';
    document.getElementById('btn-open-admin').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('student-chip').classList.add('hidden');
    showToast('Berhasil masuk ke Mode Guru (Admin)!');
    renderCurrentSlide();
    openAdminPanel('classes');
  } else {
    document.getElementById('pin-error-msg').classList.remove('hidden');
  }
}

function startStudentPreview() {
  APP.isPreviewingStudent = true;
  closeAdminPanel();
  document.getElementById('preview-bar').classList.remove('hidden');
  renderCurrentSlide();
}

function exitStudentPreview() {
  APP.isPreviewingStudent = false;
  document.getElementById('preview-bar').classList.add('hidden');
  renderCurrentSlide();
  openAdminPanel('slides');
}

/* ============================================================================
   9. PANEL GURU (ADMIN): 7 KELAS, DRAG-DROP SLIDE, TRASH, MEDIA, GAME, VERSI
   ============================================================================ */
let currentAdminTab = 'classes';
let resultFilterClass = 'X E1';
let resultPage = 1;
const PAGE_SIZE = 15;

function openAdminPanel(tab = 'classes') {
  if (APP.role !== 'teacher') { openPinModal(); return; }
  currentAdminTab = tab;
  document.getElementById('admin-overlay').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('admin-active-class-lbl').textContent = APP.draft.activeClass;
  document.getElementById('admin-version-lbl').textContent = `v${APP.published.version}.0`;
  switchAdminTab(tab);
}

function closeAdminPanel() {
  document.getElementById('admin-overlay').classList.add('hidden');
  renderCurrentSlide();
}

function markDraftDirty() {
  document.getElementById('pending-badge').classList.remove('hidden');
  persistLocal();
}

function switchAdminTab(tab) {
  currentAdminTab = tab;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-admintab]').forEach(b => {
    b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.admintab === tab);
  });
  const body = document.getElementById('admin-tab-body');

  // --- TAB 1: PENGELOLAAN 7 KELAS (X E1 - X E7) & SESI PEMBELAJARAN ---
  if (tab === 'classes') {
    const act = APP.draft.activeClass;
    const sessList = APP.draft.sessions[act] || [];
    body.innerHTML = `
      <div class="space-y-4">
        <div class="bg-[#E3F1E7] border-2 border-[#2E6F40] rounded-2xl p-4">
          <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B]">🏫 Manajemen 7 Kelas Paralel (X E1 – X E7)</h3>
          <p class="text-xs text-[#261D15] mt-1">Setiap kelas memiliki ruang penyimpanan evaluasi dan refleksi terpisah agar laporan 7 kelas tidak tercampur.</p>
          <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-3">
            ${CLASSES.map(c => {
              const subCnt = APP.submissions.filter(s => s.kelas === c).length;
              const refCnt = APP.reflections.filter(r => r.kelas === c).length;
              return `<button onclick="selectAdminClass('${c}')" class="px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl border-2 font-display font-bold text-sm transition ${c === act ? 'bg-[#1E4D2B] text-white border-[#1E4D2B]' : 'bg-white border-[#E4D3AA] hover:border-[#2E6F40]'}">
                ${c} <span class="text-[11px] font-sans opacity-80">(${subCnt} nilai • ${refCnt} refleksi)</span>
              </button>`;
            }).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="m-card p-4 space-y-3">
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <h4 class="font-display font-bold text-base text-[#1E4D2B]">📅 Daftar Sesi Pembelajaran — Kelas ${act}</h4>
            <div class="flex gap-2">
              <input id="new-session-name" type="text" placeholder="Nama sesi baru (misal: Pertemuan 2 - Pergeseran)" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] text-xs font-bold w-64">
              <button onclick="createNewSession('${act}')" class="m-btn btn-green !py-1.5 !px-3.5 text-xs">➕ Buat Sesi Baru</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="space-y-2">
            ${sessList.map(s => `
              <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl border-2 ${s.active ? 'bg-[#FDF3D7] border-[#E9B44C]' : 'bg-white border-[#E4D3AA]'} flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                <div>
                  <span class="font-display font-bold text-sm">${esc(s.name)}</span>
                  <span class="ml-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold ${s.active ? 'bg-[#2E6F40] text-white' : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-700'}">${s.active ? 'SESI AKTIF' : 'DITUTUP'}</span>
                  <div class="text-[#6E421F] mt-0.5">ID Sesi: <b>${s.id}</b> • Dibuat: ${s.createdAt}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="flex gap-2">
                  ${!s.active ? `<button onclick="activateSession('${act}','${s.id}')" class="m-btn btn-blue !py-1 !px-3 text-xs">Aktifkan</button>`
                              : `<button onclick="closeSession('${act}','${s.id}')" class="m-btn btn-ghost !py-1 !px-3 text-xs">Tutup Sesi</button>`}
                </div>
              </div>`).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  // --- TAB 2: EDITOR SLIDE, DRAG-AND-DROP URUTAN & TEMPAT SAMPAH (TRASH) ---
  if (tab === 'slides') {
    const order = APP.draft.slideOrder || [];
    const trashed = APP.draft.trashedSlides || [];
    body.innerHTML = `
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4">
        <div class="lg:col-span-7 space-y-3">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B]">📑 Susunan Slide (Seret / Drag-and-Drop untuk Mengatur Urutan)</h3>
              <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F]">Klik tombol Edit pada slide untuk mengubah judul, teks materi, atau panduan guru.</p>
            </div>
            <button onclick="addNewCustomSlide()" class="m-btn btn-green !py-1.5 !px-3.5 text-xs">➕ Tambah Slide Baru</button>
          </div>
          <div id="admin-slide-draglist" class="space-y-2">
            ${order.map((id, idx) => {
              const base = BASE_SLIDES[id] || (APP.draft.customSlides || []).find(x => x.id === id);
              if (!base) return '';
              const ov = (APP.draft.slideOverrides || {})[id] || {};
              const title = ov.title || base.title;
              return `
                <div draggable="true" data-sid="${id}" class="drag-item p-3 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] flex items-center justify-between gap-2 cursor-move hover:border-[#2E6F40]">
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                    <span class="text-gray-400 font-bold select-none">⋮⋮</span>
                    <span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-[#E3F1E7] text-[#1E4D2B] font-display font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">${idx + 1}</span>
                    <div class="truncate">
                      <div class="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm truncate">${esc(title)}</div>
                      <div class="text-[11px] text-[#6E421F]">${esc(base.group || 'Materi')}</div>

                  </div>
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                    <button onclick="editSlideForm('${id}')" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-[#FDF3D7] border border-[#E9B44C] text-xs font-bold">✏️ Edit</button>
                    ${id !== 'home' && id !== 'mode' ? `<button onclick="moveSlideToTrash('${id}')" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-[#FBE4DF] border border-[#D64933] text-xs font-bold text-[#A63220]">🗑️ Hapus</button>` : ''}
                  </div>
                </div>`;
            }).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Kolom Kanan: Form Edit Slide & Folder Slide Baru Terhapus -->
        <div class="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4">
          <div id="slide-edit-box" class="m-card p-4">
            <h4 class="font-display font-bold text-base text-[#1E4D2B]">✏️ Editor Konten Slide</h4>
            <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F] mt-1">Pilih salah satu slide di sebelah kiri dan klik tombol <b>Edit</b> untuk mengubah judul, isi tambahan, atau panduan guru.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="m-card p-4 bg-[#FAF3E0] space-y-2.5">
            <h4 class="font-display font-bold text-base text-[#A63220]">🗑️ Slide Baru Terhapus (${trashed.length})</h4>
            <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F]">Slide yang dihapus tidak langsung hilang permanen. Anda dapat memulihkannya kapan saja.</p>
            ${trashed.length ? trashed.map(t => `
              <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-[#E4D3AA] flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                <span class="font-bold truncate">${esc(t.title)}</span>
                <div class="flex gap-1 shrink-0">
                  <button onclick="restoreTrashedSlide('${t.id}')" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#E3F1E7] text-[#1E4D2B] font-bold">♻️ Pulihkan</button>
                  <button onclick="deleteTrashedForever('${t.id}')" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#D64933] text-white font-bold">Hapus Permanen</button>
                </div>
              </div>`).join('') : '<div class="text-xs italic text-[#6E421F]">Folder sampah kosong.</div>'}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;

    // Pasang Drag and Drop HTML5
    const container = document.getElementById('admin-slide-draglist');
    let dragSrc = null;
    container.querySelectorAll('.drag-item').forEach(item => {
      item.addEventListener('dragstart', () => { dragSrc = item; item.classList.add('dragging'); });
      item.addEventListener('dragend', () => { item.classList.remove('dragging'); });
      item.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
      item.addEventListener('drop', e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!dragSrc || dragSrc === item) return;
        const fromId = dragSrc.dataset.sid, toId = item.dataset.sid;
        const arr = APP.draft.slideOrder;
        const fromIdx = arr.indexOf(fromId), toIdx = arr.indexOf(toId);
        arr.splice(fromIdx, 1);
        arr.splice(toIdx, 0, fromId);
        markDraftDirty();
        switchAdminTab('slides');
      });
    });
    return;
  }

  // --- TAB 3: VIDEO YOUTUBE ---
  if (tab === 'media') {
    const yt = APP.draft.youtube || {};
    body.innerHTML = `
      <div class="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <!-- Pengaturan YouTube -->
        <div class="m-card p-5 space-y-3">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B]">🎬 Video Pembelajaran YouTube</h3>
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-extrabold cursor-pointer">
              <input id="yt-enabled" type="checkbox" ${yt.enabled ? 'checked' : ''} class="w-4 h-4 accent-[#2E6F40]">
              <span>Tampilkan di Mode Siswa</span>
            </label>
          </div>
          <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F]">Jika dinonaktifkan atau link kosong, slide video otomatis tidak akan muncul di perangkat siswa.</p>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">Tautan / URL Video YouTube</label>
            <input id="yt-url" type="url" value="${esc(yt.url || '')}" placeholder="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=..." class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] text-xs font-bold">
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">Judul Tayangan Video</label>
            <input id="yt-title" type="text" value="${esc(yt.title || '')}" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] text-xs font-bold">
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-xs font-bold mb-1">Instruksi Pengamatan untuk Siswa</label>
            <textarea id="yt-note" rows="3" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] text-xs font-bold">${esc(yt.note || '')}</textarea>
          </div>
          <button onclick="saveYoutubeSettings()" class="m-btn btn-green text-xs">💾 Simpan Pengaturan Video</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  // --- TAB 4: PILIHAN GAMES EVALUASI ---
  if (tab === 'games') {
    const gs = APP.draft.gameSettings;
    body.innerHTML = `
      <div class="space-y-4">
        <div class="m-card p-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-[#FDF3D7] border-[#E9B44C]">
          <div>
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B]">🎮 Pengaturan Sistem Permainan Evaluasi</h3>
            <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F]">Jika &gt;1 game diaktifkan, siswa melihat dashboard pilihan dan <b>hanya dapat memainkan 1 game</b> sebelum ke refleksi.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-xs font-extrabold">
            <label class="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
              <input id="gs-enabled" type="checkbox" ${gs.enabled ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="updateGameMeta()" class="w-4 h-4 accent-[#2E6F40]">
              <span>Aktifkan Fitur Game</span>
            </label>
            <label class="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
              <input id="gs-retry" type="checkbox" ${gs.allowRetry ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="updateGameMeta()" class="w-4 h-4 accent-[#2E6F40]">
              <span>Izinkan Siswa Mengulang</span>
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3.5">
          ${GAMES_CATALOG.map(g => {
            const isOn = (gs.activeGames || []).includes(g.id);
            return `
              <div class="m-card p-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 ${isOn ? 'border-[#2E6F40]' : 'opacity-65'}">
                <div>
                  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span class="text-3xl">${g.icon}</span>
                    <button onclick="toggleGameCard('${g.id}')" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-extrabold ${isOn ? 'bg-[#2E6F40] text-white' : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-700'}">
                      ${isOn ? '✅ Aktif' : 'Nonaktif'}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <h4 class="font-display font-bold text-base mt-2" style="color:${g.color}">${g.name}</h4>
                  <p class="text-xs text-[#261D15] mt-1">${g.desc}</p>
                  <div class="text-[11px] text-[#6E421F] mt-1.5"><b>Cara Main:</b> ${g.howTo}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[#E4D3AA] text-xs">
                  <span class="font-bold text-[#6E421F]">⏱️ ${g.duration}</span>
                  <button onclick="previewSingleGame('${g.id}')" class="font-extrabold text-[#2B68B8] underline">👁️ Preview Game</button>
                </div>
              </div>`;
          }).join('')}
        </div>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  // --- TAB 5: BANK SOAL & EDIT PERTANYAAN REFLEKSI ---
  if (tab === 'questions') {
    const qs = APP.draft.quizBank || [];
    const rfs = APP.draft.reflectionQuestions || [];
    body.innerHTML = `
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
        <!-- Bank Soal Evaluasi -->
        <div class="m-card p-4 space-y-3">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B]">📝 Bank Soal Evaluasi (Brain Battle)</h3>
            <button onclick="addQuizQuestion()" class="m-btn btn-blue !py-1 !px-3 text-xs">➕ Tambah Soal</button>
          </div>
          <div class="space-y-3 max-h-[55vh] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            ${qs.map((item, i) => `
              <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FAF3E0] border border-[#E4D3AA] space-y-2 text-xs">
                <div class="flex justify-between font-bold"><span>Soal #${i + 1}</span><button onclick="deleteQuizQuestion(${i})" class="text-[#D64933]">Hapus</button></div>
                <textarea onchange="updateQuizField(${i},'q',this.value)" rows="2" class="w-full p-2 rounded-xl border bg-white font-bold">${esc(item.q)}</textarea>
                ${item.o.map((opt, oi) => `
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <input type="radio" name="qz-c-${i}" ${item.c === oi ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="updateQuizField(${i},'c',${oi})">
                    <input type="text" value="${esc(opt)}" onchange="updateQuizOpt(${i},${oi},this.value)" class="flex-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border bg-white font-semibold">
                  </div>`).join('')}
                <input type="text" value="${esc(item.e || '')}" onchange="updateQuizField(${i},'e',this.value)" placeholder="Pembahasan singkat..." class="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border bg-white">
              </div>`).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Editor Pertanyaan Refleksi -->
        <div class="m-card p-4 space-y-3">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B]">💭 Edit Pertanyaan Refleksi Siswa</h3>
            <button onclick="addReflectionQuestion()" class="m-btn btn-green !py-1 !px-3 text-xs">➕ Tambah Pertanyaan</button>
          </div>
          <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F]">Pertanyaan bawaan mencakup tingkat pemahaman, materi sulit, pengalaman simulasi, hal baru, dan pertanyaan lanjutan.</p>
          <div class="space-y-2">
            ${rfs.map((rq, i) => `
              <div class="flex gap-2 items-center">
                <span class="font-display font-bold text-xs text-[#6E421F]">${i + 1}.</span>
                <input type="text" value="${esc(rq)}" onchange="updateReflectionQ(${i}, this.value)" class="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] bg-white text-xs font-bold">
                <button onclick="deleteReflectionQ(${i})" class="px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#FBE4DF] text-[#D64933] text-xs font-bold">✕</button>
              </div>`).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  // --- TAB 6: HASIL EVALUASI & REFLEKSI SISWA PER KELAS (X E1 - X E7) ---
  if (tab === 'results') {
    const clsSubs = APP.submissions.filter(s => s.kelas === resultFilterClass);
    const clsRefs = APP.reflections.filter(r => r.kelas === resultFilterClass);
    const avg = clsSubs.length ? Math.round(clsSubs.reduce((acc, x) => acc + x.score, 0) / clsSubs.length) : 0;

    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(clsSubs.length / PAGE_SIZE));
    if (resultPage > totalPages) resultPage = 1;
    const pagedSubs = clsSubs.slice((resultPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, resultPage * PAGE_SIZE);

    body.innerHTML = `
      <div class="space-y-4">
        <!-- Filter Sheet Kelas X E1 - X E7 -->
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-[#FAF3E0] p-3 rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA]">
          <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            ${CLASSES.map(c => `<button onclick="resultFilterClass='${c}'; resultPage=1; switchAdminTab('results');" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-display text-xs font-bold ${c === resultFilterClass ? 'bg-[#2E6F40] text-white' : 'bg-white border border-[#E4D3AA]'}">Sheet ${c}</button>`).join('')}
          </div>
          <div class="flex gap-2">
            <button onclick="exportClassCsv('${resultFilterClass}')" class="m-btn btn-gold !py-1.5 !px-3.5 text-xs">📥 Unduh Rekap CSV / Excel (${resultFilterClass})</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Ringkasan Statistik Kelas -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-center">
          <div class="m-card p-3"><div class="text-xs font-bold text-[#6E421F]">Total Evaluasi (${resultFilterClass})</div><div class="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-[#1E4D2B]">${clsSubs.length} Siswa</div></div>
          <div class="m-card p-3"><div class="text-xs font-bold text-[#6E421F]">Rata-Rata Skor Game</div><div class="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-[#2B68B8]">${avg} / 100</div></div>
          <div class="m-card p-3"><div class="text-xs font-bold text-[#6E421F]">Total Refleksi Masuk</div><div class="font-display font-bold text-2xl text-[#D64933]">${clsRefs.length} Respon</div></div>
        </div>

        <!-- Tabel Rekap Nilai Evaluasi Game -->
        <div class="m-card p-4 overflow-x-auto">
          <h4 class="font-display font-bold text-base text-[#1E4D2B] mb-2">🏆 Rekap Hasil Game Evaluasi — Kelas ${resultFilterClass}</h4>
          <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr class="bg-[#1E4D2B] text-white">
                <th class="p-2 rounded-tl-xl">Absen</th>
                <th class="p-2">Nama Siswa</th>
                <th class="p-2">Sesi</th>
                <th class="p-2">Game Dipilih</th>
                <th class="p-2">Skor</th>
                <th class="p-2">Durasi</th>
                <th class="p-2 rounded-tr-xl">Waktu Kirim</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody class="divide-y divide-[#E4D3AA]">
              ${pagedSubs.length ? pagedSubs.map(r => `
                <tr class="hover:bg-[#FAF3E0]">
                  <td class="p-2 font-bold">${esc(r.studentAbsen)}</td>
                  <td class="p-2 font-extrabold text-[#1E4D2B]">${esc(r.studentName)}</td>
                  <td class="p-2">${esc(r.sessionName)}</td>
                  <td class="p-2 font-bold text-[#2B68B8]">${esc(r.gameName)}</td>
                  <td class="p-2 font-display font-bold text-sm ${r.score >= 75 ? 'text-[#2E6F40]' : 'text-[#D64933]'}">${r.score}</td>
                  <td class="p-2">${r.durationSec} dtk</td>
                  <td class="p-2 text-[#6E421F]">${esc(r.submittedAt)}</td>
                </tr>`).join('') : `<tr><td colspan="7" class="p-4 text-center italic text-[#6E421F]">Belum ada data hasil evaluasi untuk kelas ${resultFilterClass}.</td></tr>`}
            </tbody>
          </table>
          ${totalPages > 1 ? `<div class="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-3 text-xs font-bold">
            <button ${resultPage === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="resultPage--; switchAdminTab('results');" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#FAF3E0] border">← Prev</button>
            <span class="py-1">Hal ${resultPage} / ${totalPages}</span>
            <button ${resultPage === totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="resultPage++; switchAdminTab('results');" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#FAF3E0] border">Next →</button>
          </div>` : ''}
        </div>

        <!-- Tabel Rekap Refleksi Siswa -->
        <div class="m-card p-4 space-y-2">
          <h4 class="font-display font-bold text-base text-[#1E4D2B]">💭 Rekap Refleksi Pembelajaran — Kelas ${resultFilterClass}</h4>
          ${clsRefs.length ? clsRefs.map(rf => `
            <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#FAF3E0] border border-[#E4D3AA] text-xs space-y-1">
              <div class="flex justify-between font-extrabold text-[#1E4D2B]">
                <span>🎓 ${esc(rf.studentName)} (Absen ${esc(rf.studentAbsen)}) — ${esc(rf.sessionName)}</span>
                <span class="text-[#6E421F] font-normal">${esc(rf.submittedAt)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 pt-1">
                ${(rf.answers || []).map((a, idx) => `<div class="bg-white p-2 rounded-xl border border-[#E4D3AA]"><b>${idx + 1}.</b> ${esc(a.answer)}</div>`).join('')}
              </div>
            </div>`).join('') : `<p class="text-xs italic text-[#6E421F]">Belum ada kiriman refleksi siswa untuk kelas ${resultFilterClass}.</p>`}
        </div>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  // --- TAB 7: RIWAYAT VERSI, UBAH PIN GURU & KONFIGURASI FIREBASE CLOUD ---
  if (tab === 'versions') {
    const fbSaved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_FIREBASE') || '';
    body.innerHTML = `
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
        <div class="m-card p-4 space-y-3">
          <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B]">🕒 Riwayat Versi Publikasi (Rollback)</h3>
          <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F]">Setiap kali Anda memublikasikan perubahan, salinan versi disimpan otomatis sehingga dapat dipulihkan jika dibutuhkan.</p>
          <div class="space-y-2 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto">
            ${APP.versionHistory.length ? APP.versionHistory.map((v, i) => `
              <div class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#FAF3E0] border border-[#E4D3AA] flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <div><b>Versi v${v.version}.0</b> • <span class="text-[#6E421F]">${esc(v.publishedAt)}</span></div>
                <button onclick="rollbackVersion(${i})" class="m-btn btn-blue !py-1 !px-3 text-xs">Pulihkan Versi Ini</button>
              </div>`).join('') : '<p class="text-xs italic text-[#6E421F]">Belum ada riwayat versi tersimpan.</p>'}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="m-card p-4 space-y-4">
          <div>
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-lg text-[#1E4D2B]">🔐 Ubah PIN Akses Guru</h3>
            <div class="flex gap-2 mt-2">
              <input id="new-guru-pin" type="password" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="PIN baru (min. 4 angka)" class="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] text-xs font-bold">
              <button onclick="changeGuruPin()" class="m-btn btn-green !py-1.5 !px-4 text-xs">Simpan PIN Baru</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="border-t border-[#E4D3AA] pt-3">
            <h3 class="font-display font-bold text-base text-[#1E4D2B]">☁️ Sinkronisasi Cloud Real-Time (Firebase Firestore)</h3>
            <p class="text-xs text-[#6E421F] mt-1">Tempelkan JSON konfigurasi Firebase Project Anda agar sinkronisasi lintas HP siswa di kelas berjalan secara real-time melalui internet:</p>
            <textarea id="fb-config-json" rows="3" placeholder='{"apiKey":"...","authDomain":"...","projectId":"..."}' class="w-full mt-2 p-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] font-mono text-[11px]">${esc(fbSaved)}</textarea>
            <button onclick="saveFirebaseConfig()" class="m-btn btn-blue !py-1.5 !px-4 text-xs mt-2">Hubungkan Cloud Firebase</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

/* ================= AKSI-AKSI DI DALAM PANEL GURU ================= */
function selectAdminClass(c) {
  APP.draft.activeClass = c;
  document.getElementById('admin-active-class-lbl').textContent = c;
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('classes');
}
function createNewSession(c) {
  const name = (document.getElementById('new-session-name')?.value || '').trim();
  if (!name) { showToast('Masukkan nama sesi pembelajaran terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
  const list = APP.draft.sessions[c] || [];
  list.forEach(s => s.active = false);
  list.unshift({
    id: 'SESI-' + c.replace(/\s+/g, '') + '-' + Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900),
    name,
    active: true,
    createdAt: new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID')
  });
  APP.draft.sessions[c] = list;
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('classes');
  showToast(`Sesi baru untuk kelas ${c} berhasil dibuat!`);
}
function activateSession(c, sid) {
  (APP.draft.sessions[c] || []).forEach(s => s.active = (s.id === sid));
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('classes');
}
function closeSession(c, sid) {
  const target = (APP.draft.sessions[c] || []).find(s => s.id === sid);
  if (target) target.active = false;
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('classes');
}

function editSlideForm(id) {
  const base = BASE_SLIDES[id] || (APP.draft.customSlides || []).find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!base) return;
  const ov = (APP.draft.slideOverrides || {})[id] || {};
  document.getElementById('slide-edit-box').innerHTML = `
    <h4 class="font-display font-bold text-base text-[#1E4D2B] mb-2">✏️ Edit Slide: ${esc(base.group || 'Slide')}</h4>
    <div class="space-y-2.5 text-xs">
      <div>
        <label class="block font-bold mb-1">Judul Slide</label>
        <input id="ed-sl-title" type="text" value="${esc(ov.title || base.title)}" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] font-bold">
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="block font-bold mb-1">Catatan / Materi Tambahan di Slide</label>
        <textarea id="ed-sl-body" rows="3" placeholder="Tambahkan ringkasan poin materi atau contoh soal untuk siswa..." class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] font-semibold">${esc(ov.customBody || base.customBody || '')}</textarea>
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="block font-bold mb-1">Panduan Mengajar Guru</label>
        <input id="ed-sl-guide" type="text" value="${esc(ov.guide || base.guide || '')}" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#E4D3AA] font-semibold">
      </div>
      <button onclick="saveSlideEdit('${id}')" class="m-btn btn-green w-full text-xs">💾 Simpan Editan Slide</button>
    </div>`;
}
function saveSlideEdit(id) {
  APP.draft.slideOverrides = APP.draft.slideOverrides || {};
  APP.draft.slideOverrides[id] = {
    title: document.getElementById('ed-sl-title').value.trim(),
    customBody: document.getElementById('ed-sl-body').value.trim(),
    guide: document.getElementById('ed-sl-guide').value.trim()
  };
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('slides');
  showToast('Perubahan slide tersimpan di draft!');
}
function addNewCustomSlide() {
  const id = 'custom_' + Date.now();
  APP.draft.customSlides = APP.draft.customSlides || [];
  APP.draft.customSlides.push({
    id,
    group: 'Materi Tambahan Guru',
    title: 'Slide Baru — Studi Kasus Tambahan',
    guide: 'Jelaskan studi kasus tambahan ini kepada siswa.',
    customBody: 'Tuliskan ringkasan materi, contoh soal, atau instruksi diskusi kelas di sini.'
  });
  APP.draft.slideOrder.splice(APP.draft.slideOrder.length - 1, 0, id);
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('slides');
  editSlideForm(id);
}
function moveSlideToTrash(id) {
  const idx = APP.draft.slideOrder.indexOf(id);
  if (idx < 0) return;
  APP.draft.slideOrder.splice(idx, 1);
  const base = BASE_SLIDES[id] || (APP.draft.customSlides || []).find(x => x.id === id);
  const ov = (APP.draft.slideOverrides || {})[id] || {};
  APP.draft.trashedSlides = APP.draft.trashedSlides || [];
  APP.draft.trashedSlides.unshift({ id, title: ov.title || base?.title || id });
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('slides');
  showToast('Slide dipindahkan ke folder Slide Baru Terhapus.');
}
function restoreTrashedSlide(id) {
  APP.draft.trashedSlides = (APP.draft.trashedSlides || []).filter(t => t.id !== id);
  if (!APP.draft.slideOrder.includes(id)) {
    APP.draft.slideOrder.splice(Math.max(0, APP.draft.slideOrder.length - 1), 0, id);
  }
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('slides');
  showToast('Slide berhasil dipulihkan!');
}
function deleteTrashedForever(id) {
  APP.draft.trashedSlides = (APP.draft.trashedSlides || []).filter(t => t.id !== id);
  APP.draft.customSlides = (APP.draft.customSlides || []).filter(c => c.id !== id);
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('slides');
}

function saveYoutubeSettings() {
  APP.draft.youtube = {
    enabled: document.getElementById('yt-enabled').checked,
    url: document.getElementById('yt-url').value.trim(),
    title: document.getElementById('yt-title').value.trim(),
    note: document.getElementById('yt-note').value.trim()
  };
  markDraftDirty();
  showToast('Pengaturan video YouTube disimpan ke draft!');
}

function updateGameMeta() {
  APP.draft.gameSettings.enabled = document.getElementById('gs-enabled').checked;
  APP.draft.gameSettings.allowRetry = document.getElementById('gs-retry').checked;
  markDraftDirty();
}
function toggleGameCard(gid) {
  const arr = APP.draft.gameSettings.activeGames || [];
  const i = arr.indexOf(gid);
  if (i >= 0) arr.splice(i, 1);
  else arr.push(gid);
  APP.draft.gameSettings.activeGames = arr;
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('games');
}
function previewSingleGame(gid) {
  closeAdminPanel();
  goToSlideById('game_zone');
  setTimeout(() => launchMiniGame(gid), 80);
}

function addQuizQuestion() {
  APP.draft.quizBank.push({ q: 'Pertanyaan ekonomi baru...', o: ['Pilihan A', 'Pilihan B', 'Pilihan C'], c: 0, e: 'Pembahasan jawaban benar.' });
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('questions');
}
function deleteQuizQuestion(i) {
  APP.draft.quizBank.splice(i, 1);
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('questions');
}
function updateQuizField(i, key, val) {
  APP.draft.quizBank[i][key] = val;
  markDraftDirty();
}
function updateQuizOpt(i, oi, val) {
  APP.draft.quizBank[i].o[oi] = val;
  markDraftDirty();
}
function addReflectionQuestion() {
  APP.draft.reflectionQuestions.push('Pertanyaan refleksi baru...');
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('questions');
}
function updateReflectionQ(i, val) {
  APP.draft.reflectionQuestions[i] = val;
  markDraftDirty();
}
function deleteReflectionQ(i) {
  APP.draft.reflectionQuestions.splice(i, 1);
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('questions');
}

/* ================= RINGKASAN PERUBAHAN & PUBLIKASI REAL-TIME ================= */
function computeDraftDiff() {
  const diffs = [];
  if (JSON.stringify(APP.draft.slideOrder) !== JSON.stringify(APP.published.slideOrder)) diffs.push('• Perubahan susunan atau jumlah slide pembelajaran');
  if (JSON.stringify(APP.draft.slideOverrides) !== JSON.stringify(APP.published.slideOverrides)) diffs.push('• Pembaruan teks judul/materi/panduan pada slide');
  if (JSON.stringify(APP.draft.youtube) !== JSON.stringify(APP.published.youtube)) diffs.push('• Perubahan pengaturan video YouTube');
  if (JSON.stringify(APP.draft.gameSettings) !== JSON.stringify(APP.published.gameSettings)) diffs.push('• Perubahan pilihan atau aturan game evaluasi');
  if (JSON.stringify(APP.draft.quizBank) !== JSON.stringify(APP.published.quizBank)) diffs.push(`• Pembaruan Bank Soal (${(APP.draft.quizBank || []).length} soal)`);
  if (JSON.stringify(APP.draft.reflectionQuestions) !== JSON.stringify(APP.published.reflectionQuestions)) diffs.push('• Pembaruan daftar pertanyaan refleksi siswa');
  if (JSON.stringify(APP.draft.sessions) !== JSON.stringify(APP.published.sessions)) diffs.push('• Pembaruan sesi pembelajaran kelas aktif');
  return diffs.length ? diffs : ['• Sinkronisasi ulang konfigurasi aktif ke seluruh perangkat siswa'];
}

function openPublishModal() {
  const diffs = computeDraftDiff();
  document.getElementById('publish-diff-list').innerHTML = diffs.map(d => `<div class="font-bold text-[#1E4D2B]">${esc(d)}</div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('modal-publish').classList.remove('hidden');
}

async function confirmPublish() {
  // Simpan versi sebelumnya ke riwayat versi untuk rollback
  APP.versionHistory.unshift(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(APP.published)));

  const nextVer = (APP.published.version || 1) + 1;
  APP.draft.version = nextVer;
  APP.draft.publishedAt = new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID');
  APP.published = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(APP.draft));

  persistLocal();
  if (bc) bc.postMessage({ type: 'PUBLISHED_UPDATE', payload: APP.published });
  if (APP.firebaseDb) {
    try {
      await APP.firebaseDb.collection('sman1kutasari_media').doc('published').set(APP.published);
    } catch (e) { /* tersimpan lokal & broadcast */ }
  }

  document.getElementById('modal-publish').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('pending-badge').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('admin-version-lbl').textContent = `v${nextVer}.0`;
  updateSyncHeader();
  renderCurrentSlide();
  showToast(`🚀 Berhasil dipublikasikan (v${nextVer}.0)! Semua perangkat siswa otomatis diperbarui.`);
}

function rollbackVersion(idx) {
  const target = APP.versionHistory[idx];
  if (!target) return;
  APP.draft = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(target));
  markDraftDirty();
  switchAdminTab('versions');
  showToast(`Versi v${target.version}.0 dimuat ke editor. Klik "Publikasikan Perubahan" untuk mengaktifkannya.`);
}

async function changeGuruPin() {
  const np = (document.getElementById('new-guru-pin')?.value || '').trim();
  if (np.length < 4) { showToast('PIN baru minimal 4 karakter/angka.'); return; }
  APP.pinHash = await sha256Hex(PIN_SALT + np);
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_PINHASH', APP.pinHash);
  document.getElementById('new-guru-pin').value = '';
  showToast('🔐 PIN rahasia guru berhasil diperbarui & dienkripsi!');
}

function saveFirebaseConfig() {
  const raw = document.getElementById('fb-config-json').value.trim();
  if (!raw) {
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_FIREBASE');
    showToast('Konfigurasi Firebase dihapus.');
    return;
  }
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY + '_FIREBASE', JSON.stringify(parsed));
    initFirebaseIfConfigured();
    showToast('☁️ Konfigurasi Cloud Firebase tersimpan & terhubung!');
  } catch (e) {
    showToast('Format JSON tidak valid. Pastikan tanda kutip sesuai format JSON.');
  }
}

/* ================= EKSPOR CSV / EXCEL PER KELAS (X E1 - X E7) ================= */
function exportClassCsv(kelas) {
  const subs = APP.submissions.filter(s => s.kelas === kelas);
  const refs = APP.reflections.filter(r => r.kelas === kelas);
  let csv = '\uFEFF'; // BOM UTF-8 agar rapi saat dibuka di Microsoft Excel
  csv += `REKAP HASIL EVALUASI & REFLEKSI SISWA - SMA NEGERI 1 KUTASARI\n`;
  csv += `Kelas: ${kelas} | Diekspor pada: ${new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID')}\n\n`;
  csv += `BAGIAN 1: NILAI EVALUASI GAME\n`;
  csv += `No Absen,Nama Siswa,Kelas,Sesi,Permainan Dipilih,Skor,Benar,Total Soal,Durasi (detik),Waktu Kirim\n`;
  subs.forEach(s => {
    csv += `"${s.studentAbsen}","${s.studentName}","${s.kelas}","${s.sessionName}","${s.gameName}",${s.score},${s.correctCount},${s.totalCount},${s.durationSec},"${s.submittedAt}"\n`;
  });
  csv += `\nBAGIAN 2: REFLEKSI PEMBELAJARAN\n`;
  csv += `No Absen,Nama Siswa,Kelas,Sesi,Jawaban 1,Jawaban 2,Jawaban 3,Jawaban 4,Jawaban 5,Waktu Kirim\n`;
  refs.forEach(r => {
    const ans = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => `"${(r.answers[i]?.answer || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(',');
    csv += `"${r.studentAbsen}","${r.studentName}","${r.kelas}","${r.sessionName}",${ans},"${r.submittedAt}"\n`;
  });

  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = `Rekap_Ekonomi_${kelas.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}_SMAN1Kutasari.csv`;
  a.click();
  showToast(`📥 File rekap kelas ${kelas} berhasil diunduh!`);
}

/* ============================================================================
   10. INISIALISASI GLOBAL & EVENT LISTENER
   ============================================================================ */
window.onload = function () {
  loadStateFromStorage();
  initFirebaseIfConfigured();
  updateSyncHeader();

  // Navigasi Footer
  document.getElementById('btn-prev').onclick = () => goToSlide(APP.currentSlideIdx - 1);
  document.getElementById('btn-next').onclick = () => {
    const slides = getVisibleSlides();
    if (APP.currentSlideIdx >= slides.length - 1) goToSlide(0);
    else goToSlide(APP.currentSlideIdx + 1);
  };

  // Menu Kanan Atas
  document.getElementById('btn-menu').onclick = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    document.getElementById('menu-drawer').classList.toggle('hidden');
  };
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const drawer = document.getElementById('menu-drawer');
    if (!drawer.contains(e.target) && e.target.id !== 'btn-menu') {
      drawer.classList.add('hidden');
    }
  });

  // Tombol Pilih Mode & Panel Guru
  document.getElementById('btn-mode-switch').onclick = () => goToSlideById('mode');
  document.getElementById('btn-open-admin').onclick = () => openAdminPanel('classes');

  // Enter pada modal PIN
  document.getElementById('input-guru-pin').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') verifyGuruPin();
  });

  // Tombol Kurangi / Matikan Animasi
  document.getElementById('btn-toggle-anim').onclick = () => {
    const off = document.body.classList.toggle('reduce-motion');
    document.getElementById('anim-label').textContent = off ? 'Animasi: Mati' : 'Animasi: Aktif';
    showToast(off ? 'Animasi dimatikan untuk kenyamanan tampilan.' : 'Animasi vektor diaktifkan kembali.');
  };

  // Navigasi Keyboard Kiri/Kanan (saat tidak mengetik di input)
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(document.activeElement.tagName)) return;
    if (!document.getElementById('admin-overlay').classList.contains('hidden')) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') document.getElementById('btn-next').click();
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') document.getElementById('btn-prev').click();
  });

  renderCurrentSlide();
};
</script>
